description: Canonical Google Sheets schema for the IOS v2.1 personal deployment layer (Issue #242). Authoritative field names and semantics for the GAS Dashboard (Phase B) and the one-prompt installer (Phase C). See docs/v2.1-architecture.md for the full design rationale.

当前持仓.purpose: Source of truth for what the user currently holds. Overrides any stale portfolio data a Scheduled Task or chat memory might otherwise assume.

fields.name: 代码
fields.notes: Ticker/security code. Reserved value 'FUND-SLEEVE' (Issue #259): an optional aggregate row representing a fund sleeve as one position -- see the 投资信托明细 tab's own rules for how its 当前市值 total reconciles against this row without double-counting.

fields.name: 市场
fields.notes: Exchange/market.

fields.name: 平均成本
fields.notes: Blank means unknown -- never reconstructed or defaulted by an automated writer.

fields.name: 参考买入价/区间
fields.notes: User-maintained reference buy price or range for this holding (e.g. 'add more below 38') -- an ongoing decision anchor the user sets, distinct from 平均成本 (the actual historical cost basis). Blank means not set -- never defaulted from 平均成本 or any other field, never computed by a writer.

rules: Only rows with 状态=持有 AND 持有数量 > 0 count as current holdings.
A blank 平均成本 is unknown, not zero -- never silently filled in by any writer.
参考买入价/区间 is user-entered reference data, not a system-computed target -- it must never be inferred from 平均成本 or any other field, and a writer must never fabricate one where the user left it blank.

A row with 代码=FUND-SLEEVE (Issue #259) represents an entire fund sleeve as one aggregate position. Its own 持有数量/平均成本 are not used to derive the sleeve's current total value -- that comes from summing 投资信托明细.当前市值 across the matching detail rows (matched by 账户 when the FUND-SLEEVE row sets one, otherwise all detail rows). A consumer computing a portfolio total must use either this aggregate row or the 投资信托明细 sum for the same scope, never both additively -- see 投资信托明细's own rules.

交易记录.purpose: Transaction history for context only. Never used to override 当前持仓's own state.

fields.name: 操作
fields.notes: e.g. buy/sell -- not a fixed enum, market-dependent.

rules: History/context only -- never authoritative for current holdings state.

观察名单.purpose: Candidates under research, explicitly not holdings.

fields.name: 优先级
fields.notes: Canonical values defined by Issue #293's weekly priority review (see prompts/weekly-portfolio-report.md's '观察名单周度优先级复盘' section) -- 高/中/低, never the pre-Issue-#293 English high/medium/low a legacy row may still carry. A writer treats a legacy English value as equivalent when reading but must never write it again; blank means not yet assessed, not low.

rules: Never counted as holdings in any view or aggregate, in the Dashboard or in any report.

账户状态.purpose: Durable account/capital facts (Issue #259) -- current available cash by currency/account, New NISA remaining capacity, and related funding state -- as canonical Sheet facts rather than a Task-embedded chat context. Introduced in schema_version 2; absent entirely on a schema_version 1 installation that has not migrated (see migration_policy).

fields.name: 账户
fields.notes: Account/broker label, same vocabulary as 当前持仓.账户.

fields.name: 可用现金
fields.notes: Current available cash for this 账户/币种. Blank means unknown -- never defaulted to zero. This is the field that satisfies agents/weekly-agent.md's required '当前现金或资金状态' input: at least one row across this tab with a non-blank 可用现金 and a 数据时间 is required for that input to count as supplied from the Sheet.

fields.name: NISA成长投资额度剩余
fields.notes: New NISA growth-investment (成长投资枠) remaining capacity for this 账户. Blank means unknown/not applicable -- a 建议输入 (agents/weekly-agent.md classifies NISA state as suggested, not required); its absence alone must never trigger 不可执行.

fields.name: NISA积立额度剩余
fields.notes: New NISA tsumitate (つみたて投资枠) remaining capacity for this 账户. Same blank/建议输入 semantics as NISA成长投资额度剩余.

fields.name: 本年计划追加资金
fields.notes: Optional user-declared planned additional capital for the current year. Never inferred -- blank means not declared, not zero.

fields.name: 定期定额扣款
fields.notes: Free-text description of current recurring tsumitate/DCA instructions where the user has supplied them (e.g. amount, frequency, target fund). Not a fixed enum -- brokerage conventions vary too much to normalize.

fields.name: 数据时间
fields.notes: as_of date this row's facts were current as of. Required whenever a row exists, so staleness can be judged the same way weekly_cash_context's free-text description already was (old but present is a noted gap, not a run-blocker).

fields.name: 来源
fields.notes: Provenance/source label for this row (e.g. 'brokerage app screenshot 2026-08-01', 'user-reported'). Optional but recommended for anything other than a live brokerage feed this schema does not integrate with.

rules: Multiple rows are expected -- one per (账户, 币种) combination the user wants to track, mirroring 当前持仓's own per-position rows.
可用现金/NISA成长投资额度剩余/NISA积立额度剩余/本年计划追加资金 blank means unknown, never zero -- never reconstructed or defaulted by any writer or by the Dashboard.

Only 可用现金 (plus 数据时间) is required for agents/weekly-agent.md's required '当前现金或资金状态' input; NISA/计划追加资金/定期定额扣款 remain 建议输入 (suggested) per that same document -- their absence is a noted information gap, never grounds for 不可执行 on its own.

Which source is authoritative is decided by the recorded _安装状态.schema_version, never merely by whether this tab happens to exist -- a Sheet whose schema_version already says 2 must never fall back to _安装状态.weekly_cash_context just because 账户状态 was found missing, since that could be a deleted/renamed tab rather than a genuine pre-migration Sheet, and the legacy field is retired (may hold a stale or inert sentinel value) once schema_version reaches 2.

schema_version >= 2: 账户状态 is the sole authoritative source, full stop. A tab that exists but whose rows all have a blank 可用现金 is equivalent to 'not provided' for the required-input check -- it does NOT fall back to _安装状态.weekly_cash_context. A tab that is missing/unreadable under a recorded schema_version >= 2 is a schema-incompatible state and must be Blocked, not silently treated as a pre-migration Sheet -- consulting the legacy field here would leave two independently stale copies of the same fact, exactly the operational problem Issue #259 was opened to remove.

schema_version == 1 (or _安装状态 itself is confirmed absent, i.e. a Sheet that predates the _安装状态 mechanism entirely): 账户状态 is expected absent, and the legacy _安装状态.weekly_cash_context mechanism is the sole source -- never treated as 'user declined' on a pre-migration Sheet.

A read failure on this tab, or on _安装状态 itself (permission/API error, timeout), is never treated the same as either tab being confirmed absent -- same fail-closed distinction sheet-schema.json's own _安装状态 rules already establish for that tab.

投资信托明细.purpose: Per-fund detail rows (Issue #259) sufficient to reconcile an aggregate 当前持仓 FUND-SLEEVE row and analyze S&P 500 / All Country / concentrated-tech overlap across a user's fund holdings, without requiring fabricated units or cost basis when the brokerage view doesn't expose them. Introduced in schema_version 2.

fields.name: 基金名称
fields.notes: Fund name as the user's brokerage displays it. A stable security identifier is preferred when available (see 代码) but never required -- some brokerage views only expose a name.

fields.name: 代码
fields.notes: Stable identifier (ticker/ISIN/local fund code) when available. Blank rather than synthesized when the brokerage view doesn't provide one -- never invented to fill the column.

fields.name: 账户
fields.notes: Which 账户 holds this fund, for matching against a 当前持仓 FUND-SLEEVE row scoped to the same 账户.

fields.name: NISA分类
fields.notes: NISA bucket/account classification for this fund (e.g. 成长投资枠/积立投资枠/课税账户) -- free text, not a fixed enum, since exact institutional labels vary.

fields.name: 当前市值
fields.notes: Current market value as the user's brokerage reports it -- never computed/estimated by a writer. This is the field 当前持仓's FUND-SLEEVE aggregate row reconciles against (see that tab's own rules).

fields.name: 未实现盈亏
fields.notes: Optional unrealized P/L as reported by the brokerage. Blank means not supplied, never computed from 当前市值 minus an assumed cost basis.

fields.name: 数据时间
fields.notes: as_of date this row's facts were current as of.

rules: Multiple rows per fund sleeve are expected -- this tab is the detail a 当前持仓 FUND-SLEEVE aggregate row summarizes, not a duplicate of it.

The authoritative current total value for a fund sleeve is the sum of this tab's 当前市值 across its matching rows (matched by 账户 when the 当前持仓 FUND-SLEEVE row sets one, otherwise all rows) -- never the FUND-SLEEVE row's own 持有数量/平均成本, which are not meaningful units for a fund sleeve.

A consumer must never add this tab's summed value AND a separately-derived 当前持仓 FUND-SLEEVE figure together as two portfolio components -- that double-counts the same underlying position. Use one reconciled figure.
代码/units/cost basis are never fabricated when the brokerage view doesn't expose them -- blank stays blank.

This tab is entirely absent (not merely empty) on a schema_version 1 installation or on any installation where the user has not chosen to track fund-sleeve detail -- its absence is not an error and 当前持仓 continues to work as a single aggregate row with no reconciliation available in that case.

入场计划.purpose: Durable, Deep-Dive-owned execution plan (Issue #298) for a holding or watchlist candidate -- a long-term valuation anchor plus a small, bounded, human-confirmed execution layer (staged entry zones, timing/technical conditions, no-chase and invalidation conditions). Introduced in schema_version 4. Facts tab, same layer as 当前持仓/观察名单: Daily/Weekly evaluate the active row against current price and snapshot that evaluation into 报告持仓, but never rewrite this tab's own static fields themselves -- only a Deep Dive creates or materially updates a plan.

fields.name: 计划ID
fields.notes: Fresh id (e.g. UUID) minted per plan version, never reused -- analogous to 生成ID. Stable across this version's lifetime; a material update mints a new 计划ID (a new row), it never edits an existing plan row's substantive fields in place.

fields.name: 代码
fields.notes: Matches 当前持仓.代码 or 观察名单.代码. At most one row for a given 代码 should be 状态=active at steady state -- see 状态's own notes for the transient-overlap/tie-break rule.

fields.name: 版本
fields.notes: Monotonically increasing ordinal within this 代码's plan lineage, starting at 1. Human-readable version marker; 计划ID is the actual stable identity of this specific version.

fields.name: 上一版本ID
fields.notes: 此版本取代的上一个 计划ID，首个版本留空。构成可追溯的 lineage 链，供历史查阅——取代关系仅靠这个字段追溯，不隐式依赖行顺序或时间戳。

fields.name: 状态
fields.notes: Exactly one row per 代码 is meant to be active at steady state; a reader must never delete/ignore superseded rows (see migration_policy -- report/plan history is not disposable). Write order for a material update: (1) write the new row as 状态=active and verify it was written, THEN (2) flip the previous active row for this 代码 to 状态=superseded and verify that too -- so a reader can transiently see two active rows for the same 代码 during that narrow window. This is not corruption: a reader facing more than one 状态=active row for a 代码 must treat the one with the highest 版本 as authoritative and simply ignore the other(s), never error or block. This clean resolution only works because a normal write-order overlap always differs in 版本 (the new row is always one higher). If two or more 状态=active rows for the same 代码 instead share the SAME maximum 版本, that is not the expected transient overlap -- it is a genuine data anomaly (a botched retry, concurrent edits, or manual corruption) with no version-based way to pick a winner. See this tab's own rules for the required tie-break/fail-closed handling of that case; a reader must never break such a tie by row order, insertion order, or any other implicit/nondeterministic signal.

fields.name: 数据时间
fields.notes: as_of date this plan version was created or materially updated -- the Deep Dive date, not a Task run date.

fields.name: 长期估值锚点
fields.notes: Deep-Dive-owned long-term valuation anchor (e.g. '$355附近'), free text. Blank means unknown/not yet established -- never fabricated by any writer, including Daily/Weekly.

fields.name: 计划新增仓位说明
fields.notes: The *denominator* every 区间N占比 below is a percentage of: a free-text, non-executable description of the planned incremental allocation this plan's zones are sized against (e.g. 'this plan targets roughly $50,000 of new buying, in USD' or 'approx 2% of total portfolio NAV as of 数据时间, not a fixed dollar figure'). This is a descriptive basis for interpreting/auditing the percentages, never an order size, trade instruction, or anything a Task may execute against. **Write invariant**: if this plan version writes any non-blank 区间1占比/区间2占比/区间3占比, this field must be written non-blank in that same write -- a writer must never leave a percentage with no stated basis. If the basis genuinely cannot be stated yet, the correct write is to leave all three 区间N占比 blank for this version (区间N价格 alone can still be written) rather than writing an orphaned percentage. **Read invariant**: a row found violating this (any 区间N占比 non-blank while this field is blank -- not expected from a compliant writer, but a reader must not assume every historical/external row is compliant) must have every one of its 区间N占比 treated as unusable/blank by the reader, exactly as if this field were blank; a reader must never use a percentage that lacks a stated basis regardless of what numeric value it holds.

fields.name: 区间1价格
fields.notes: First (highest-priority) of up to three ordered entry zones. Free text (a price or a narrow range), not a fixed format.

fields.name: 区间1占比
fields.notes: Maximum share (0-100) of 计划新增仓位说明's stated planned incremental allocation this zone represents -- never portfolio weight, never an executed trade quantity, never a share of the whole position. Blank means unknown/not specified. Uninterpretable if 计划新增仓位说明 itself is blank (see that field's own notes).

fields.name: 区间2价格
fields.notes: Second entry zone, same semantics as 区间1价格. Blank if the plan only defines one zone.

fields.name: 区间2占比
fields.notes: Same semantics as 区间1占比, for 区间2价格.

fields.name: 区间3价格
fields.notes: Third entry zone, same semantics as 区间1价格. Blank if the plan defines fewer than three zones.

fields.name: 区间3占比
fields.notes: Same semantics as 区间1占比, for 区间3价格.

fields.name: 技术确认条件
fields.notes: Bounded timing/technical confirmation condition used only for execution timing within an already-decided zone (e.g. 'wait for a close above the 50-day average') -- never a substitute for or override of the IOS priority order. Blank means no such condition is part of this plan.

fields.name: 不追高条件
fields.notes: Free-text no-chase condition: the price/consequence state under which the plan says not to add, even inside a zone. Blank means not specified.

fields.name: 失效条件
fields.notes: Thesis-invalidating / pause-and-review condition, distinct from an ordinary price decline -- a normal drawdown inside the plan's own zones is not, by itself, an invalidation. Blank means not specified; blank is never treated as 'no invalidation is possible', only as 'not yet articulated'.

fields.name: 下一验证证据
fields.notes: The next concrete evidence item this plan is waiting on (e.g. next earnings print, a specific disclosure).

fields.name: 计划复核触发
fields.notes: The condition or staleness rule (e.g. 'refresh after Q3 earnings, or after 90 days regardless') that should trigger a Deep Dive refresh of this plan. Weekly uses this (plus 数据时间's age) to decide when to surface a needs-refresh follow-up -- see 报告待办.

fields.name: 依据来源
fields.notes: Provenance note for this plan version (e.g. 'Weekly Deep Dive 2026-09-10'). Not a citation system -- a short human-readable trace of where this version came from.

fields.name: 计划新增仓位币种
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Persisted currency for the planned incremental allocation basis described in 计划新增仓位说明 (e.g. 'USD'), making the basis a structured (currency, amount) pair rather than free text alone. **Write invariant**: if this plan version writes a non-blank 计划新增仓位金额, this field and 计划新增仓位说明 must also be non-blank in the same write -- the three fields are written together or not at all. Placed after 备注 (not grouped with 计划新增仓位说明) because this column was added via the additive, append-only schema_version 6 upgrade -- see the same append-only convention established for schema_version 3/4/5's own additions.

fields.name: 计划新增仓位金额
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Persisted numeric amount for the planned incremental allocation basis, in 计划新增仓位币种. Never an executed trade quantity and never portfolio weight -- same non-executable-basis semantics as 计划新增仓位说明, just structured so 建议订单规模说明 on 报告持仓 can be computed mechanically (区间N占比 percent of this amount) instead of parsed from free text. Blank means the basis has not been given a structured amount yet -- 计划新增仓位说明/区间N占比 can still exist on their own (the pre-Phase-2 contract); a writer must never fabricate this field merely to make 建议限价/建议订单规模说明 computable.

fields.name: 订单类型
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text order-type policy this plan intends for its entry zones (e.g. '限价单，不追价'), set only by a Deep Dive. Not a fixed enum -- brokerage/market order-type vocabulary varies too much to normalize, same reasoning as 交易记录.操作. Blank means not yet specified; Daily/Weekly must never invent one. Issue #306 (schema_version 8): a Deep Dive also states the plan's one execution path here as the literal 执行路径=估值区间限价, 执行路径=收盘确认 (with exchange, timezone and official-close condition) or 执行路径=事件确认 (with the named event). A plan without exactly one such declaration has no defined execution timing: no report may infer one, and it can never reach 今日行动=可人工准备限价单. A declaration (next batch, execution path, upper-bound policy) counts only when it is about this plan's own 代码 and batches; text naming another 代码/company (e.g. a copied cross-symbol budget note) is a contradiction that yields 需补全, never a declaration.

fields.name: 订单有效期
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text policy for how long a prepared order should remain valid (e.g. '当日有效'/'7 个自然日'), set only by a Deep Dive. This is the plan's general policy, distinct from 入场执行反馈.订单有效期截止, which is the concrete expiry date of one actual placed order. Blank means not yet specified.

fields.name: 跳空处理规则
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text policy for what to do when the next trading session's price gaps beyond a zone's limit price (e.g. '开盘超过限价则不追价，等待价格回落或触发复核'), set only by a Deep Dive. Governs 报告持仓.跳空处理提示. Blank means not yet specified -- Daily/Weekly must never invent a gap rule the plan never stated, and must never silently raise a limit price to chase a gap.

fields.name: 区间1上一版本对应区间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 3 (PR #305 review finding #1). Structured, machine-checkable predecessor mapping for 区间1: either blank (no 上一版本ID exists yet -- this is the zone's first-ever plan version), a zone label from 上一版本ID's own plan version ('区间1'/'区间2'/'区间3', meaning this zone's order-feedback history continues that ancestor zone's, even if the exact price band or ordinal position changed -- e.g. a revision that reorders a v1 区间2 into this version's 区间1 sets this field to '区间2'), or the literal '新增资金' (this zone is declared genuinely fresh, unrelated capital -- the lineage scan in 入场执行反馈's own rules stops here and does not look at any ancestor zone for this tranche). Write invariant: whenever this plan version's own 上一版本ID is non-blank AND 区间1价格 is non-blank, this field must also be non-blank -- a reader finding it blank in that situation must treat the batch mapping as unresolved/ambiguous and fail closed (报告持仓.准备状态 cannot reach 可准备订单 for that zone) rather than guess by matching ordinal position. Supersedes the free-text 备注/计划新增仓位说明 '全新资金' escape hatch from the round 2 fix, which was not machine-checkable.

fields.name: 区间2上一版本对应区间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 3 (PR #305 review finding #1). Structured, machine-checkable predecessor mapping for 区间2: either blank (no 上一版本ID exists yet -- this is the zone's first-ever plan version), a zone label from 上一版本ID's own plan version ('区间1'/'区间2'/'区间3', meaning this zone's order-feedback history continues that ancestor zone's, even if the exact price band or ordinal position changed -- e.g. a revision that reorders a v1 区间2 into this version's 区间1 sets this field to '区间2'), or the literal '新增资金' (this zone is declared genuinely fresh, unrelated capital -- the lineage scan in 入场执行反馈's own rules stops here and does not look at any ancestor zone for this tranche). Write invariant: whenever this plan version's own 上一版本ID is non-blank AND 区间2价格 is non-blank, this field must also be non-blank -- a reader finding it blank in that situation must treat the batch mapping as unresolved/ambiguous and fail closed (报告持仓.准备状态 cannot reach 可准备订单 for that zone) rather than guess by matching ordinal position. Supersedes the free-text 备注/计划新增仓位说明 '全新资金' escape hatch from the round 2 fix, which was not machine-checkable.

fields.name: 区间3上一版本对应区间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 3 (PR #305 review finding #1). Structured, machine-checkable predecessor mapping for 区间3: either blank (no 上一版本ID exists yet -- this is the zone's first-ever plan version), a zone label from 上一版本ID's own plan version ('区间1'/'区间2'/'区间3', meaning this zone's order-feedback history continues that ancestor zone's, even if the exact price band or ordinal position changed -- e.g. a revision that reorders a v1 区间2 into this version's 区间1 sets this field to '区间2'), or the literal '新增资金' (this zone is declared genuinely fresh, unrelated capital -- the lineage scan in 入场执行反馈's own rules stops here and does not look at any ancestor zone for this tranche). Write invariant: whenever this plan version's own 上一版本ID is non-blank AND 区间3价格 is non-blank, this field must also be non-blank -- a reader finding it blank in that situation must treat the batch mapping as unresolved/ambiguous and fail closed (报告持仓.准备状态 cannot reach 可准备订单 for that zone) rather than guess by matching ordinal position. Supersedes the free-text 备注/计划新增仓位说明 '全新资金' escape hatch from the round 2 fix, which was not machine-checkable.

fields.name: 交易单位确认
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 3 (PR #305 review finding #2). Free-text confirmation, set by a Deep Dive or recorded from the user, that this instrument's trading unit (board lot size) is known and compatible with the planned 计划新增仓位金额 allocation (e.g. '100股/手，已确认可 整手买入'). Blank means not yet confirmed -- this is a required preflight input for 报告持仓.准备状态=可准备订单, not something Daily/Weekly may assume or fabricate (see that field's own notes); its absence routes to 计划未完善停在核对, the same treatment as a blank 订单类型. Bound to 订单资金账户 (round 5, PR #305 review finding #1): this confirmation is only usable when 订单资金账户 is itself non-blank, since trading-unit support can differ by broker/account.

fields.name: 订单类型可用性确认
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 3 (PR #305 review finding #2). Free-text confirmation, set by a Deep Dive or recorded from the user, that the funding account's broker actually supports this plan's stated 订单类型 for this instrument (e.g. '券商确认支持限价单'). Blank means not yet confirmed -- required preflight input for 报告持仓.准备状态=可准备订单; its absence routes to 计划未完善停在核对, same treatment as a blank 订单类型. Bound to 订单资金账户 (round 5, PR #305 review finding #1): this confirmation is only usable when 订单资金账户 is itself non-blank, since broker order-type support can differ by account.

fields.name: 换汇可行性确认
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 3 (PR #305 review finding #2). Free-text confirmation, set by a Deep Dive or recorded from the user, that converting from the funding account's held currency into 计划新增仓位币种 is feasible (e.g. '账户支持日元兑美元自动换汇'). Only required when 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the funding account's own 币种 in 账户状态 -- blank is fine when the currencies already match, since there is nothing to confirm. Required and blank when currencies differ routes 报告持仓.准备状态 to 计划未完善停在核对. Bound to 订单资金账户 (round 5, PR #305 review finding #1, replacing the round 4 per-field 换汇可行性确认账户): this confirmation is about THAT specific account's own conversion support, never a generic statement -- see 订单资金账户's own notes.

fields.name: 交易单位确认时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 4 (PR #305 review finding #1). The date 交易单位确认 was actually observed/stated -- these two fields are written together or not at all (same pairing rule as 计划新增仓位币种/计划新增仓位金额/计划新增仓位说明). 报告持仓.准备状态 treats 交易单位确认 as stale (equivalent to blank) when this date is more than 30 calendar days before the evaluating 报告持仓 row's own 报告日期 -- a confirmation this old is not evidence the trading unit still applies, since broker/instrument rules can change independently of the plan row itself. See 报告持仓.准备状态's own notes for the exact freshness rule.

fields.name: 订单类型可用性确认时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 4 (PR #305 review finding #1). The date 订单类型可用性确认 was actually observed/stated -- written together with it or not at all. Same 30-day freshness rule as 交易单位确认时间: older than 30 calendar days before the evaluating 报告持仓 row's own 报告日期 makes 订单类型可用性确认 stale, treated as blank by 报告持仓.准备状态.

fields.name: 订单资金账户
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 5 (PR #305 review finding #1, replacing round 4's 换汇可行性确认账户 -- the problem is not specific to currency conversion). The exact 账户状态.账户 identifier of the ONE funding account that will actually place this order -- the single account every account-dependent manual preflight confirmation (交易单位确认, 订单类型可用性确认, 换汇可行性确认) is bound to, since trading-unit support, order-type support, and conversion feasibility can all differ by broker/account even when two accounts share the same 币种. Required (non-blank) whenever any of those three confirmation fields is non-blank -- a confirmation with no declared account proves nothing about the account actually used. 报告持仓.准备状态's cash preflight step (see that field's own notes) must look up 账户状态 by this EXACT 账户 value, never by matching currency alone -- two same-currency accounts are not interchangeable, and a confirmation about one account must never authorize an order funded by another.

fields.name: 换汇可行性确认时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2, round 4 (PR #305 review finding #1). The date 换汇可行性确认 was actually observed/stated -- paired with 换汇可行性确认 (round 5: the account binding itself moved to the shared 订单资金账户 field, no longer paired here). Same 30-day freshness rule: older than 30 calendar days before the evaluating 报告持仓 row's own 报告日期 makes 换汇可行性确认 stale, treated as blank.

rules: Only a Deep Dive (a materially deeper research pass, typically performed as part of Weekly per prompts/weekly-portfolio-report.md's '观察名单周度优先级复盘' section, or an ad-hoc research session) creates or materially updates a plan row's substantive fields (长期估值锚点/区间*/技术确认条件/不追高条件/失效条件/下一验证证据/计划复核触发). Daily and Weekly Task runs read the active plan to evaluate it against current price and snapshot that evaluation into 报告持仓 (see that tab's 执行状态/当前区间/需要复核 fields) -- they never rewrite this tab's own rows.

区间1占比/区间2占比/区间3占比 are always relative to the plan's own stated planned incremental allocation, never portfolio weight and never an executed trade quantity -- a reader/writer must never conflate the two. That planned incremental allocation is itself a stated, persisted fact, not an implicit convention: it lives in this row's own 计划新增仓位说明 field (a free-text, non-executable amount/currency/scope description). A percentage on a row whose 计划新增仓位说明 is blank has no stated denominator and must be treated as uninterpretable/unknown by every reader, never assumed to mean 'percent of the whole position' or any other implicit basis. This is a hard write invariant, not just interpretation guidance: a writer must never write a non-blank 区间N占比 in the same version whose 计划新增仓位说明 is blank -- if the basis cannot yet be stated, that version's 区间N占比 fields stay blank too (区间N价格 alone may still be written); see 计划新增仓位说明's own field notes for the exact write/read rule.

Active-row selection tie-break: among 状态=active rows for a 代码, the one with the highest 版本 is authoritative (see this tab's 状态 field notes for why a normal write-order overlap never produces a same-version tie). If two or more active rows instead share that maximum 版本 -- a genuine anomaly, not the expected transient overlap -- break the tie by the latest 数据时间 among them. If 数据时间 is also tied or otherwise ambiguous, that 代码 has no reliably determinable active plan for this evaluation: Daily/Weekly must leave all five of 报告持仓's plan-evaluation fields (入场计划ID/执行状态/当前区间/需要复核/入场计划估值锚点) blank or false for that 代码, identical in shape to the no-active-plan case, and additionally write a 报告待办 row (跟进类型=可执行) flagging the tied-version anomaly for manual cleanup -- never guess by row order, insertion order, or any other implicit signal, and never silently drop the flag. 需要复核 is deliberately NOT set true for this case: it is a signal about one specific, reliably-identified plan version's own 计划复核触发 condition, and there is no such version to attach it to here -- the tied-version anomaly is reported exclusively through the 报告待办 row, never by forcing 需要复核 true on a row whose other four plan fields are simultaneously blank (that combination is self-contradictory and must never be produced).

A material update never edits an existing row's substantive fields in place -- it writes a new row (fresh 计划ID, incremented 版本, 上一版本ID pointing at the row it supersedes, 状态=active) and then flips the previous active row to 状态=superseded, in that order. Superseded rows are retained for history, never deleted, matching this schema's general migration_policy (report/plan history is not disposable). This two-step write is not idempotent by itself -- a retry after step one (new row written) but before step two (old row superseded) must not blindly restart from a fresh 计划ID, or an interrupted attempt turns into a duplicate/orphaned version every time it is retried. The recovery identity must be derived entirely from a fresh read of this tab's own persisted state (a stateless restart has no other memory to draw on) -- specifically from the SAME highest-版本 active-row selection every other reader already performs (see 状态's field notes), never from a remembered 'the plan I was superseding was X' value, which a naive implementation might otherwise compute from a now-stale pre-interruption read: after step one succeeds, a fresh read's own highest-版本 selection returns the *new* row, not the one it supersedes, so keying recovery off 'whatever the current selection points at' would never rediscover its own unfinished work. Before minting a new 计划ID for a 代码, a writer must instead: (1) select that 代码's current active row the normal way (highest 版本 among 状态=active rows; if that selection is itself ambiguous under the tied-版本 rule below, stop and flag via 报告待办 exactly as the read-side rule requires, without writing anything for this 代码 this run); (2) if the selected row's own 上一版本ID is non-blank AND the row it points to is itself still 状态=active in this same read, the selected row is the already-written artifact of an incomplete prior supersession -- resume by completing only the outstanding step (flip that predecessor row to 状态=superseded and verify), reusing the selected row's existing 计划ID, never minting another; (3) otherwise (the selected row's predecessor is already 状态=superseded, or the selected row has no predecessor at all -- a first-ever plan) the mutation itself is settled, but the *orchestrating attempt* may not be: an acknowledgement of that settled write can itself be lost (the append succeeds, or the full two-step sequence succeeds, but the writer never durably records 'this succeeded' before being interrupted), and a blind retry at that point would mint a spurious extra version even though nothing is actually incomplete in the data. So before minting anything, compare the selected row's own substantive fields (长期估值锚点/计划新增仓位说明/区间1-3价格/区间1-3占比/技术确认条件/不追高条件/失效条件/下一验证证据/计划复核触发/依据来源) against the content this Deep Dive currently intends to write -- deliberately excluding 计划ID/版本/上一版本ID/状态/数据时间, which are bookkeeping, not content. An exact match means the selected row already *is* the realization of this exact material update (an acknowledgement-loss replay, whether of a first-ever append or of a fully completed two-step supersession) -- treat it as done, mint nothing. Any difference means this is a genuinely new material update (whether the first attempt at it, or a separate later same-day update following one that already completed) -- proceed to mint a new 计划ID/版本 superseding the selected row. Nothing about any of this depends on 数据时间 or same-day reasoning; it depends only on whether the data already reflects the exact change being made.

A row with no 代码 match in 当前持仓/观察名单 (e.g. a holding that was later sold, or a watchlist candidate that was removed) is not an error -- it simply becomes irrelevant to current Daily/Weekly evaluation; it is not deleted or hidden by any writer.

This tab is entirely absent (not merely empty) on a pre-schema_version-4 installation. Its absence, or the absence of any 状态=active row for a given 代码, is not Blocked -- Daily/Weekly/Dashboard fall back to the existing 当前持仓.参考买入价/区间 or 观察名单.理想买入区间 display for that 代码, exactly as before this feature existed.

Issue #303 Phase 2 write invariant: 计划新增仓位币种/计划新增仓位金额/计划新增仓位说明 are written together or not at all -- a writer must never write 计划新增仓位金额 non-blank while either of the other two is blank, mirroring the existing 区间N占比/计划新增仓位说明 invariant above. A reader finding 计划新增仓位金额 non-blank with 计划新增仓位币种 or 计划新增仓位说明 blank must treat 计划新增仓位金额 as unusable, exactly as if it were itself blank -- never assume a default currency or compute 建议订单规模说明 from an amount with no stated currency. 订单类型/订单有效期/跳空处理规则 are independent optional policy fields with no such pairing requirement; each is simply blank until a Deep Dive states it, and Daily/Weekly must never fabricate one that is blank -- see 报告持仓.准备状态's own field-value-shape rules for how a blank policy field stops order preparation at a check step rather than inventing one.

Cross-plan-version batch mapping via 区间N上一版本对应区间 (PR #305 round 3 review finding #1 -- supersedes the free-text 全新资金 escape hatch from the round 2 fix, which was not machine-checkable and could not handle a zone reorder across versions). 入场执行反馈's lineage scan (see that tab's own rules) does not assume a zone label (区间1/区间2/区间3) means the same tranche across versions by raw ordinal position -- it follows each zone's own 区间N上一版本对应区间 field as an explicit pointer: if the active plan's 区间1 has 区间1上一版本对应区间='区间2', the scan continues into 上一版本ID's own 区间2 lineage (which may itself point further back through its own mapping field, continuing the chain across multiple revisions), correctly finding a live order that moved from one ordinal position to another across a reorder -- the exact round 2 gap this closes. '新增资金' breaks the chain deliberately: no ancestor zone is scanned for a zone the Deep Dive has explicitly declared fresh. A blank mapping where the write invariant (see that field's own notes) required a non-blank value is itself unresolved -- a reader must fail closed (treat the batch mapping as ambiguous, never guess by matching ordinal position) rather than silently falling back to same-label matching.

Manual preflight confirmation fields 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 (PR #305 round 3 review finding #2) are how this system satisfies Issue #303's required execution preflight (cash, currency conversion, trading unit, supported order type) without a broker integration, which is explicitly out of scope -- they are user-authorized facts the same way 账户状态's own fields are, never values Daily/Weekly infer, assume, or fabricate. 交易单位确认 and 订单类型可用性确认 are required (non-blank) for every zone that reaches 报告持仓.准备状态=可准备订单; 换汇可行性确认 is required only when 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the funding account's own 币种 in 账户状态. A writer must never populate one of these fields with a generic placeholder to satisfy the non-blank requirement -- see each field's own notes for what a real confirmation looks like; a reader treats a blank required confirmation exactly like a blank 订单类型 (报告持仓.准备状态 stops at 计划未完善停在核对).

Manual preflight confirmation freshness and account binding (PR #305 round 4 review finding #1, corrected round 5 -- round 4's per-field 换汇可行性确认账户 only bound 换汇可行性确认 to an account, leaving 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认 unbound, so with two same-currency 账户状态 rows a confirmation about account A could still authorize an order funded by account B; round 5 replaces it with the single shared 订单资金账户 field covering all three). 交易单位确认/交易单位确认时间 are written together or not at all; 订单类型可用性确认/订单类型可用性确认时间 are written together or not at all; 换汇可行性确认/换汇可行性确认时间 are written together or not at all. 订单资金账户 is required (non-blank) whenever ANY of those three confirmations is non-blank -- a confirmation with no declared funding account proves nothing about the account actually used, since trading-unit support, order-type support, and conversion feasibility can all differ by broker/account even within the same 币种. A reader treats a confirmation as unusable (equivalent to blank, same 计划未完善停在核对 consequence as a genuinely blank confirmation) in any of: (a) its own 确认时间 is more than 30 calendar days before the evaluating 报告持仓 row's own 报告日期, OR its 确认时间 is AFTER that row's own 报告日期 (a future-dated confirmation is invalid, not automatically fresh -- round 5 finding #1 explicitly corrects an age<=30 check that a negative age trivially satisfied) -- in both cases stale/invalid, since trading-unit/order-type/conversion rules can change independently of this plan row; (b) 订单资金账户 is blank, or does not match the exact 账户状态.账户 that actually supplies 可用现金 in that same evaluation's own cash preflight step -- a confirmation bound to a different account, or to no account at all, proves nothing about the account actually funding this order. A writer must never backdate, post-date, or omit these fields to dodge the freshness/account checks.

入场执行反馈.purpose: Durable, user-authorized fact record (Issue #303 Phase 2) of what actually happened to a prepared order against one 入场计划 zone -- not ordered, pending, partially filled, filled, cancelled, or unknown. Same layer as 账户状态: Daily/Weekly may record a new row only when the user explicitly states their own order status that session, never inferred, derived from price action, or fabricated. Introduced in schema_version 6. Append-only, same lineage discipline as 入场计划: a status update is a NEW row, never an in-place edit, so the full history of what was reported and when stays reviewable.

fields.name: 反馈ID
fields.notes: Fresh id (e.g. UUID) minted per feedback row, never reused -- analogous to 计划ID. A later status update for the same (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) is a new row with a new 反馈ID, never an edit of this one.

fields.name: 代码
fields.notes: Matches 当前持仓.代码 or 观察名单.代码.

fields.name: 关联计划ID
fields.notes: FK to 入场计划.计划ID -- pins this feedback to the exact plan version it was prepared against. A feedback row referencing a since-superseded 计划ID is not an error (history is not disposable) but is no longer the plan version Daily/Weekly evaluate against going forward -- see 报告持仓.最近订单状态's own notes on how a reader reconciles this.

fields.name: 对应区间
fields.notes: Which of the plan's 区间1/区间2/区间3 this feedback concerns (e.g. '区间1'). Blank means the feedback applies to the plan's pending preparation generally rather than one specific zone (e.g. a blanket cancellation). This zone label identifies a position within ONE specific plan version (`关联计划ID`) -- it is NOT, by itself, a stable identity across versions (PR #305 round 3 review finding #1 correction to the round 1/round 2 approach: raw ordinal matching missed a zone that a revision reorders, e.g. a v1 区间2 becoming a v2 区间1). A lookup for an existing order on a zone of the CURRENT active plan must instead walk that zone's own 入场计划.区间N上一版本对应区间 pointer (see that field's own notes) back through the lineage, one version at a time, each time checking 入场执行反馈 rows keyed to that ancestor version's own `计划ID` and the zone label the mapping named at that step -- not by assuming the SAME zone label persists unchanged across every version. The chain stops when it reaches a version with no 上一版本ID (a true first version) or a mapping of '新增资金' (the Deep Dive explicitly declared that zone fresh, unrelated capital). `关联计划ID` itself is still written as whichever plan version was actually active when the user reported the status -- that audit trail is never rewritten; the structured mapping only changes how a later read walks back to find it.

fields.name: 订单状态
fields.notes: The user's own reported status for this prepared order, verbatim -- Daily/Weekly only ever read or record what the user stated this session; this field is never inferred from price action, time elapsed, or any other signal. 未知 is the explicit value for 'user reported they are not sure / information is stale', distinct from simply having no feedback row at all (which is also unknown, but with no row to point to).

fields.name: 已成交数量
fields.notes: Quantity actually filled so far, as the user reported it. Blank means not reported/not applicable (e.g. 订单状态=未下单). Never computed or estimated by a writer -- this is the user's own fact, reconciled against 交易记录/当前持仓 by the user, not by the Task.

fields.name: 已成交均价
fields.notes: Average fill price so far, as the user reported it. Same never-computed semantics as 已成交数量.

fields.name: 剩余待成交数量
fields.notes: Remaining unfilled quantity on this order, as the user reported it. Used by Daily/Weekly to avoid re-suggesting the already-placed portion of a zone's prepared order -- see 报告持仓.准备状态's own notes.

fields.name: 订单有效期截止
fields.notes: Concrete expiry date of this one actual placed order, as the user reported it -- distinct from 入场计划.订单有效期, which is the plan's general policy (e.g. '当日有效') rather than one order's own date. Blank means not reported or not applicable.

fields.name: 数据时间
fields.notes: as_of date this feedback was current as of -- used for the same latest-wins recency tie-break 账户状态 already uses when more than one row exists for the same (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间).

fields.name: 来源
fields.notes: Provenance label (e.g. '用户在 Daily 会话中提供'). Optional but recommended, same convention as 账户状态.来源.

rules: Daily/Weekly may write a new row to this tab only when the user explicitly states their own current order status for a specific plan/zone in that session -- never inferred from price movement, time elapsed, 当前持仓 changes, or any other indirect signal, and never fabricated to make a report look complete. No user statement this session means no new row -- the previous row (if any) for that (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) remains the latest known fact.

Multiple rows per (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) are expected -- each status update is a new row (same append-only discipline as 入场计划's own versioning), never an in-place edit. The latest 数据时间 row for a given (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) is the authoritative current status; older rows are retained for history, never deleted.

已挂单 does not mean 已成交, and the absence of any row for a (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) does not mean no order exists -- it means no status has been recorded yet, which is a distinct 未知 state from an explicit 订单状态=未知 row. A reader must never treat a missing row as 未下单.
实际成交以 交易记录/当前持仓 为事实源，不是这个 tab -- 已成交 状态只是用户自报的进度信号，用来避免 Daily/Weekly 对同一笔已经执行的配置重复建议，不能反过来用它覆盖或代替 交易记录/当前持仓 的事实。出现两者不一致时（例如用户报告已成交但 当前持仓 未反映），Daily/Weekly 必须提示人工核对，不得自行判定哪一个是对的。

This tab is entirely absent (not merely empty) on a pre-schema_version-6 installation, or simply has no row for a given (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) -- neither is Blocked. Daily/Weekly treat a missing row as 未知 feedback and evaluate 报告持仓.准备状态 accordingly (see that field's own notes), never as license to assume no order exists.

Idempotency/replay (PR #305 review finding #4): before minting a fresh 反馈ID, the writer compares the candidate new row's 订单状态/已成交数量/已成交均价/剩余待成交数量/订单有效期截止/备注 against the most recent existing row for the same (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) with 数据时间 equal to today's report date; if every one of those fields is identical, this is a retried write of the same already-recorded fact, not a new event, and the writer must skip the write rather than append a duplicate row. A genuinely new user statement is always written, even if it happens to match an older (not-today) row's values.

Same-day tie-break (PR #305 review finding #4): 数据时间 is a date, not a timestamp, so two distinct legitimate updates for the same (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) on the same calendar date are not distinguishable by 数据时间 alone. The writer must never treat same-date rows as simultaneous or interchangeable -- it always appends a true update as a new row strictly after the row it supersedes, and a reader resolves a same-date tie by physical append order (the later-appended row, i.e. the one nearer the bottom of the tab, wins), never by row content, assumed recency, or guesswork.

Cancellation does not erase a prior fill (PR #305 round 7 review): 已取消 or 未下单 describes the status of the REMAINDER of an order -- the part still pending or never placed -- never a reversal of shares already bought under that same (代码, 关联计划ID, 对应区间) key. A reader resolving this key's latest status to 已取消/未下单 must still scan that key's WHOLE row history for any evidence of a fill: either a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量, OR a row whose own 订单状态 is itself 部分成交/已成交 (已成交数量 is optional per this tab's own field notes -- blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero,' so a 部分成交/已成交 STATUS is itself proof execution happened even when no quantity was ever supplied) (including on the 已取消/未下单 row itself, which may legitimately restate a partial fill's final tally); finding either form of evidence means this key is not safely 'clear' -- 报告持仓.准备状态 must treat it as 无法确认 pending manual reconciliation against 已成交数量/交易记录/当前持仓, never as license to prepare the original full tranche again. A later row that simply leaves 已成交数量 blank does not retroactively erase an earlier row's recorded fill, whether that earlier fill was recorded by quantity or by status alone -- silence on the cancelling row is not evidence the fill never happened (PR #305 round 8 review). Beyond that: this tab has no broker synchronization, only manual user reports, so once ANY row for this key was ever reported 已挂单 (an order placed), a LATER 已取消/未下单 row cannot be trusted as genuinely clear merely because no fill evidence was ever recorded either -- a partial fill could have happened between the 已挂单 report and the cancellation and simply never been disclosed (PR #305 round 9 review). In that situation the 已取消/未下单 row itself must affirmatively state 已成交数量=0 (an explicit zero, not a blank) before the key counts as reconciled; absence of a recorded fill is not proof of zero consumption. A key that was NEVER reported 已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消 at all (every row, including the current one, is 未下单) has nothing that could have filled, so it needs no such explicit-zero confirmation -- but 已取消 ITSELF implies an order existed to cancel (PR #305 round 10 review): a key whose first/only ever report is 已取消 is NOT exempt just because IOS never separately saw a 已挂单 row for it, and a later 未下单 is not exempt either if an earlier 已取消/已挂单/部分成交/已成交 anywhere in this key's history already proves an order once existed -- only 未下单 carries no such implication on its own, and only when nothing else in the key's history contradicts that. Only a key whose entire history shows no fill evidence at all (已成交数量 blank/zero throughout AND no 部分成交/已成交 status recorded), AND (if any row anywhere in its history, including a 已取消 row itself, implies an order existed) an explicit 已成交数量=0 on the clearing row, is genuinely clear.

报告摘要.purpose: One row per generated report (Daily or Weekly); the report id's primary record and the atomic commit point for that report's current generation (see report_write_protocol below).

fields.name: 报告ID
fields.notes: daily-YYYY-MM-DD or weekly-YYYY-MM-DD -- the stable business key for this report.

fields.name: 生成ID
fields.notes: Fresh id (e.g. UUID) minted per write attempt, never reused across attempts/retries. The value here is the ONLY 生成ID whose 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 rows are considered live for this 报告ID -- see report_write_protocol.

fields.name: 核心状态
fields.notes: States explicitly when the report is Blocked (a required tab/column was unreadable or schema-incompatible). A tab that was read successfully but is simply empty (e.g. no watchlist rows) is a valid result, never Blocked -- see blocked_vs_empty in docs/v2.1-architecture.md.

rules: Writing/updating this row for a 报告ID is step 4 (Switch) of report_write_protocol -- it happens only after every 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 row for the new 生成ID has been written and verified.
A single row write to this tab is the only operation this schema treats as atomic; nothing else in the four-tab write is assumed atomic.

报告持仓.purpose: Per-asset detail rows for a given (报告ID, 生成ID), covering both holdings and watchlist candidates discussed in that report.

fields.name: 生成ID
fields.notes: Must match the 生成ID currently referenced by this 报告ID's 报告摘要 row to be considered live -- see report_write_protocol.

fields.name: 资产类型
fields.notes: Must distinguish holdings from watchlist candidates -- watchlist rows are never rendered as holdings.

fields.name: IOS状态
fields.notes: For newly written 资产类型=watchlist rows, canonical recommended-next-action vocabulary is exactly 研究建仓 / 等待估值 / 等待价格 / 继续观察 / 降低优先级. It is report-generation-owned research semantics, not a Dashboard-derived value. 研究建仓 means research whether to establish an initial position, never an immediate buy. Legacy non-empty values remain readable for historical preservation and readers must show unknown legacy values neutrally.

fields.name: 参考买入价/区间
fields.notes: Snapshot at report-generation time, since a historical report row must stand on its own (see migration_policy). For 资产类型=holding, copied from 当前持仓.参考买入价/区间; for 资产类型=watchlist, derived by the writer from 观察名单.理想买入区间. Blank if the source was blank -- never fabricated.

fields.name: 当前价格
fields.notes: Market price at report-generation time, if the Task's data source provided one. Blank if unavailable -- never fabricated.

fields.name: 价格位置
fields.notes: The writer's qualitative placement of 当前价格 relative to 参考买入价/区间, when both are available -- descriptive positioning only, never a buy/sell signal. These four values are the ONLY ones a writer may produce; a finer-grained phrase (e.g. '略高于区间') must be rounded to the closest of the four, never invented, so Task/Sheet/Dashboard/history readers never have to interpret a bespoke phrasing. Blank/unavailable input is 未知, never a guessed direction. The Dashboard renders this verbatim and never computes it itself; it also still recognizes some legacy '参考'-worded values from earlier history for backward-compatible rendering, but a writer must never produce them.

fields.name: 优先级
fields.notes: Report-time snapshot of 观察名单.优先级 (see that field's own notes on the canonical Issue #293 values and legacy English equivalence) for 资产类型=watchlist rows; for 资产类型=holding rows this is typically blank, since 当前持仓 has no equivalent priority concept.

fields.name: 入场计划ID
fields.notes: Issue #298, schema_version 4. FK to 入场计划.计划ID -- the specific plan version this row's 执行状态/当前区间/入场计划估值锚点 were evaluated against. This field, not 执行状态, is what selects which primary display a reader shows for this row: non-blank means an active plan existed at evaluation time and the plan-based display (入场计划估值锚点 + 执行状态, with an explicit neutral 'unavailable' state when 执行状态 itself is blank -- see that field's notes) is primary; blank means no active 入场计划 row existed for this 代码 at report-generation time, and readers fall back to 参考买入价/区间/价格位置 exactly as before this feature existed. A reader must never select the display path by whether 执行状态 is blank -- that conflates 'no plan' with 'plan exists but could not be evaluated this run', which are different states requiring different fallback text. Placed after 排序 (rather than grouped with the other price fields) because this column was added via the additive, append-only schema_version 4 upgrade -- an existing installation's 报告持仓 header gets these five columns appended at the end, so the canonical field order here must match physical append position exactly (see the same append-only convention established for schema_version 3's 跟进类型).

fields.name: 执行状态
fields.notes: Issue #298. Report-time evaluation of the active 入场计划 against current price/conditions -- computed by the writer (Daily or Weekly), never by the Dashboard, and never by re-estimating the plan's own zones/anchor. Blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank (no active plan) OR the source data needed to evaluate it was unavailable this run (an active plan exists but could not be evaluated) OR (Issue #306, schema_version 8) the active plan has no valid priced zone at all (every 区间N价格 blank or not a price) -- never fabricated. 等待确认 and 可小额开始 require the quote to sit inside one priced zone (当前区间 equals exactly that zone label); 等待价格/接近区间 require at least one priced zone to compare against. 'Waiting for research evidence / no zones built yet' is never 等待确认: it is blank 执行状态 with 准备状态=计划未完善停在核对 and 今日行动=先核对缺项. These are different states: a reader distinguishes them by 入场计划ID (see that field's notes), rendering an explicit neutral 'status unavailable' badge in the second case rather than silently falling back to the legacy 价格位置 badge, which would compete with the plan-based display the acceptance criteria forbid. 暂停复核 reflects the plan's own 失效条件 having been triggered, not an automatic sell signal.

fields.name: 当前区间
fields.notes: Issue #298. Which of 入场计划 的 区间1/区间2/区间3 the current price currently falls in, or a short free-text note when it falls in none (e.g. between zones, above all zones). Blank whenever 执行状态 is blank.

fields.name: 需要复核
fields.notes: Issue #298. True when this row's reliably-selected active 入场计划 has hit its own 计划复核触发 condition or staleness rule and should get a Deep Dive refresh -- Weekly-computed; Daily may read but should not need to set this. When true, Weekly must also surface a corresponding 报告待办 row so the follow-up is actionable, not just a flag buried in 报告持仓. Deliberately NOT set true for the tied-maximum-版本 anomaly (入场计划's own rules) -- that case has no single reliably-identified plan version for 需要复核 to be about, so all five plan fields including this one stay blank/false, and the anomaly is reported exclusively through its own 报告待办 row. Blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank (no plan, or the tied-version anomaly) or the plan exists but 计划复核触发 could not itself be evaluated this run.

fields.name: 入场计划估值锚点
fields.notes: Issue #298. A verbatim, report-time snapshot of the referenced plan version's (入场计划ID's) own 长期估值锚点 field, copied by the writer at evaluation time -- never derived, reworded, or recomputed. This is what makes the plan anchor history-safe and Dashboard-renderable without a cross-tab join: 入场计划 rows are only ever superseded, never edited in place, but the Dashboard never reads 入场计划 directly (see that tab's own notes) -- this snapshot on 报告持仓 is the only copy it ever renders, matching the same snapshot discipline already used for 参考买入价/区间 (itself often snapshotted from 观察名单.理想买入区间). Blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank; also blank (never a fabricated placeholder) when the referenced plan's own 长期估值锚点 was itself unknown/blank.

fields.name: 入场计划版本
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. A verbatim snapshot of the referenced plan version's own 版本 (e.g. 2), copied at evaluation time -- same snapshot discipline as 入场计划估值锚点, never recomputed. Lets a human read 'plan v2' directly off the report row without decoding 入场计划ID's opaque id. Depends only on which plan version was selected, never on current price -- so it follows the SAME shape as 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点, not the 执行状态-dependent fields below: populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated (including the missing-evaluation-data case), blank only when 入场计划ID itself is blank.

fields.name: 入场计划数据时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. A verbatim snapshot of the referenced plan version's own 数据时间 (the Deep Dive date that plan version was created/materially updated), copied at evaluation time. Lets a reader judge plan age/staleness without joining back into 入场计划. Same shape as 入场计划版本 above -- depends only on plan selection, populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, blank only when 入场计划ID itself is blank.

fields.name: 行情截至时间
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text as-of label for the 当前价格 quote this evaluation used (e.g. '2026-10-13 收盘', or an exchange-local timestamp the data source supplied) -- distinct from 报告日期 because a quote can be delayed or sourced from a prior close while the report itself is dated today. Never fabricated to look more precise than the source actually was. Blank whenever there is no active plan, the active plan could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly), or this run's price data was itself unavailable -- in all three cases there is no quote to label (round 2 review correction: this field must never carry a '无法确认'/'计划未完善' diagnostic message itself -- 当前阻碍 carries that; this field only ever holds a genuine quote label or stays blank). Even when evaluation succeeded, this field may legitimately stay blank -- not an incomplete-plan case -- when the data source itself supplied no distinct as-of label beyond 报告日期; that is a property of the data source, not something the writer can supply by fabricating a time.

fields.name: 当前阻碍
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text, report-time blocked-explanation field -- round 2 review correction: unlike 执行状态/当前区间, this field is NOT blank merely because 执行状态 could not be computed; a reader needs a blocked explanation precisely when the execution enum is unavailable, not less so. Covers four situations, never a new investment judgment invented by the writer -- every one is derived from an already-known, already-documented fact: (1) no active plan exists for this 代码 -- a fixed, non-fabricated explanation that research/valuation is incomplete, and that any existing 参考买入价/区间 is not order authorization (Issue #303 scenario 1); (2) the active plan could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- an explanation that the plan needs manual cleanup, consistent with the 报告待办 flag already written for this case; (3) an active plan was reliably selected but this run's price/evaluation data was unavailable -- an explicit message starting with '无法确认：' naming what was missing (e.g. '无法确认：当前价格缺失'), never silently blank and never a fabricated guess; (4) an active plan was reliably selected and evaluated -- synthesized from the plan's own 技术确认条件/不追高条件/失效条件 plus the price/zone relationship, or an explicit message starting with '计划未完善：' when the plan itself doesn't specify the needed condition. The ONLY blank case is a reliably-selected, evaluated active plan at 执行状态=可小额开始 -- nothing is blocking.

fields.name: 下次检查
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text next check/remediation field -- round 2 review correction: like 当前阻碍, this field does NOT share 执行状态's blank shape, and in fact has no blank case of its own once schema_version 5 is adopted. Covers the same four situations as 当前阻碍: (1) no active plan -- names the remediation itself (complete research/valuation; have a Deep Dive establish a plan) rather than a date, restating that an existing reference price is not order authorization; (2) tied-version anomaly -- names waiting for the manual cleanup already flagged via 报告待办; (3) price/evaluation data unavailable -- an explicit '无法确认：' message naming what is being waited on (e.g. '无法确认：等待下次价格数据可用后重新评估'); (4) an active plan was reliably selected and evaluated, at ANY 执行状态 value including 可小额开始 -- sourced from the plan's own 下一验证证据/计划复核触发 (or a close-confirmation framing tied to 技术确认条件), which are plan facts independent of this run's price, so this content survives case (3) too once the plan itself is known; if the plan specifies neither, an explicit '计划未完善：' message rather than a blank cell or a guessed date. A condition being satisfied is a conclusion as of this evaluation's as-of time only, never a standing real-time signal -- manual review before acting is still required.

fields.name: 停止条件说明
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text snapshot explaining when this specific pending-entry attempt should be cancelled or paused, sourced from the plan's own 不追高条件/失效条件 -- round 2 review correction: both source conditions are plan facts independent of current price, so unlike 当前阻碍/下次检查 this field needs no missing-evaluation-data diagnostic of its own. It follows 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点/入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间's own shape instead: populated whenever an active plan was reliably selected (whether or not this run's price data was available), blank only when there is no active plan at all or it could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- nothing to state a stop condition about. Explicitly distinct from a sell signal on the existing holding -- cancelling/pausing a planned incremental buy is never the same as a decision to reduce or exit the position already held, and this field must never be worded to imply the latter. When a reliably-selected plan specifies neither 不追高条件 nor 失效条件, the writer must write an explicit incomplete-plan message (e.g. '计划未完善：未设置不追高条件或失效条件') rather than leaving the cell blank or fabricating a stop condition the plan never stated.

fields.name: 较上次变化说明
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 1. Free-text comparison against this 代码's immediately-previous live report row of the same 报告类型 (the most recent prior 报告ID whose 报告持仓 row for this 代码 was/is live per the read contract -- not necessarily the same 生成ID). Round 2 review correction: follows 停止条件说明's shape (populated whenever an active plan was reliably selected, independent of this run's price data), not 执行状态's shape. Distinguishes a plan-version change (入场计划ID differs from that prior row) from a fact-only change under the same plan version (e.g. price moved, 执行状态 changed) from this run's own price/evaluation data being unavailable (an explicit note, e.g. '无法确认：本次评估数据缺失，暂无法确定执行状态较上次的变化', never silently blank) from no material change at all (written concisely, e.g. '继续等待，无变化'). When there is no comparable prior report row for this 代码, the writer must say so explicitly (e.g. '首次评估，无可比历史') rather than fabricating a comparison. Blank only when there is no active plan at all or it could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- nothing to compare.

fields.name: 准备状态
values: 已有有效订单不重复建议
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2 (revised after PR #305 review, ten rounds). The central order-preparation state -- whether this row is ready for the user to manually prepare one order, computed by the writer via transparent mechanical lookup/arithmetic against an already-existing, traceable 入场计划 (never a new budget/threshold/entry-point decision -- see the narrowed Daily boundary in docs/v2.1-architecture.md). Decided in this fixed, fail-closed order: (0) no active plan at all, or it could not be reliably selected (tied-maximum-版本 anomaly) -- blank, same shape as 入场计划版本; (1) an active plan was reliably selected but this run's price/evaluation data was unavailable (执行状态 itself blank for that reason, distinct from case 0) -- 无法确认; (2) 执行状态 is populated but is not 可小额开始 -- 无需准备 (nothing to prepare yet); (3) 执行状态=可小额开始: walk this zone's 区间N上一版本对应区间 chain (see 入场计划's own field notes and 入场执行反馈's own 对应区间 notes for the exact structured-mapping lookup -- it follows the explicit predecessor pointer at each version, not raw ordinal-label matching, so a zone that a revision reorders is still found) -- an explicit 已挂单/部分成交/已成交 status anywhere in that chain that has not expired is 已有有效订单不重复建议 unconditionally, with no remaining-capacity/剩余待成交数量 recomputation and no fresh 建议订单规模说明 for a partially filled zone (manual verification against 剩余待成交数量/交易记录/当前持仓 is the user's own next step, per that tab's rules); an explicit 未知 status, or an 已挂单/部分成交 whose 订单有效期截止 has passed with no newer row updating the status, is 无法确认; no row anywhere in the resolved chain is ALSO 无法确认, never a reason to proceed (缺少订单记录不等于不存在订单: the user may have placed a real broker order the system was never told about); a chain step whose own 区间N上一版本对应区间 is blank when the write invariant required it non-blank is an unresolved mapping -- fail closed to 无法确认, never fall back to guessing by ordinal position; only an explicit 未下单/已取消 status at the head of the chain is affirmative evidence that no order occupies this zone's tranche, and even that is fail-closed on THREE separate conditions: freshness (if its 数据时间 predates the active plan version's own 数据时间, it is stale and the result is 无法确认, reconfirm under the current version) AND fill history (PR #305 round 7 review, corrected round 8: if ANY row ever recorded for this exact (计划ID,区间) key -- including this 未下单/已取消 row itself -- has a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量, OR has a 订单状态 of 部分成交/已成交 (已成交数量 is optional per 入场执行反馈's own field notes -- blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero,' so the STATUS alone is itself fill evidence even when no quantity was ever supplied), this is not safely clear; a 已取消/未下单 report describes the now-cancelled/never-placed REMAINDER of an order, never a reversal of shares already bought, so a prior fill -- by quantity or by status alone -- is real, irreversible capital that this status can never erase -- even when the cancelling row itself leaves 已成交数量 blank, an earlier row's recorded fill still counts, since silence on the cancellation is not evidence the fill didn't happen; the result is 无法确认, manual reconciliation against 已成交数量/交易记录/当前持仓 required, never 可准备订单 on the strength of an unexamined cancellation) AND affirmative zero-fill confirmation (PR #305 round 9 review, corrected round 10: this tab has no broker synchronization, so once this key's history shows ANY status implying an order existed -- 已挂单/部分成交/已成交, OR 已取消 itself, since cancelling something implies it existed to be cancelled (round 10: a key whose first/only ever report is 已取消 is NOT exempt just because IOS never separately saw a 已挂单 row for it) -- a later 已取消/未下单 with no recorded fill evidence is STILL not safe to treat as clear; a partial fill could have occurred before that clearing report and simply never been disclosed; the clearing 未下单/已取消 row itself must affirmatively state 已成交数量=0, an explicit zero rather than a blank, before this key counts as reconciled, else 无法确认; only a key whose ENTIRE history is 未下单 (never 已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消 at all, including on the row itself) has nothing that could have filled, so it is exempt from this explicit-zero requirement); only a fresh, affirmative 未下单/已取消 with NO recorded fill evidence anywhere in that key's history, AND (when any row in that key's history implies an order existed) an explicit 已成交数量=0 on the clearing row, lets the writer continue to case (4); (4) with no order already occupying this zone's tranche per case (3), check the plan's own 订单类型/订单有效期/计划新增仓位金额/计划新增仓位币种, plus the manual preflight confirmations 交易单位确认 and 订单类型可用性确认 (always required), plus 换汇可行性确认 (required only when 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the funding account's own 币种 in 账户状态) -- a confirmation counts as present only if it is also fresh (0-30 days old, never future-dated) and account-matched against the single shared 订单资金账户 field: see 交易单位确认时间/订单类型可用性确认时间/换汇可行性确认时间 and 订单资金账户's own field notes for the exact rule (PR #305 round 4 finding #1, corrected round 5 -- round 4's per-field 换汇可行性确认账户 left 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认 unbound to any account, and its freshness check let a future-dated confirmation pass) -- a stale, future-dated, unbound, or account-mismatched confirmation is treated exactly like a blank one, never silently honored because the text field itself is non-blank; all required fields non-blank AND fresh AND (where applicable) account-matched continues to case (5); any one blank/stale/mismatched is 计划未完善停在核对 instead -- the writer must never fabricate a missing order parameter or preflight confirmation, nor backdate a confirmation's own timestamp, to reach 可准备订单 (PR #305 round 3 review finding #2: these manual, user-authorized confirmations are how this system checks trading unit, order-type support, and conversion feasibility without a broker integration -- never a standing disclaimer in place of an actual check); (5) plan-level budget reservation across the WHOLE plan lineage (PR #305 round 4 finding #2, corrected round 5 -- round 4 only ever walked the active version's own sibling zones, which misses a historical zone that has NO successor in the active version at all, e.g. a predecessor's 区间3 with a live order that the active version simply dropped rather than continuing under any label): first, walk the chain (case (3)'s mechanism) for every zone of the ACTIVE version with a non-blank 区间N价格 (not only the zone being prepared), recording every (计划ID, 区间) pair visited by any of those walks as 'claimed'; second, collect every (计划ID, 区间) pair across the ENTIRE lineage (the active version and every ancestor reachable via 上一版本ID) that has a non-blank 区间N价格, and for every such pair NOT in 'claimed' ('orphaned' -- no active-version zone's chain ever reaches it), walk a chain from THAT pair too (the same way, since an orphan can itself have its own further predecessor), adding everything it visits to 'claimed' as well, until no unclaimed pairs remain. Any orphan chain that resolves unresolved (no row anywhere in it, 未知, expired-unconfirmed, or an unresolved mapping) makes the active plan's total consumption unbounded, exactly as an unresolved sibling does -- the zone being prepared is ALSO 无法确认. Every live, unexpired 已挂单/部分成交/已成交 found -- whether via a sibling's chain or an orphan's -- contributes its reserved amount from the HISTORICAL plan version actually named by that feedback row's own 关联计划ID (that version's own 区间{label}占比 x that SAME version's own 计划新增仓位金额, never recomputed against the active version's possibly-different numbers) -- BUT ONLY when that historical version's own 计划新增仓位币种 is IDENTICAL to the active version's own 计划新增仓位币种 (PR #305 round 6 review finding #1): a plan revision that changed the stated currency makes that historical reservation's amount impossible to net against the active budget as a raw number (10,000 of one currency is not 10,000 of another), and this system does no currency conversion, so a currency-mismatched historical reservation is itself unresolved -- the whole budget calculation fails closed exactly as an unresolved chain does, never summed in as an unconverted number; a chain resolving to a fresh, affirmative 未下单/已取消, or to 新增资金, contributes zero. Sum every claimed pair's reserved amount (excluding the zone being prepared itself), subtract from the active version's own 计划新增仓位金额 to get the remaining plan budget, and compare against the zone being prepared's own order amount (its 区间N占比 x the active version's own 计划新增仓位金额): exceeding the remaining plan budget is 无法确认 (name the shortfall -- reservations found, plan total, and amount needed -- in 当前阻碍), never 可准备订单 on a budget check that only ever looked at the active version's own zones; staying within it continues to case (6); (6) cash preflight: 账户状态 must affirmatively show 可用现金 for the EXACT account named by 订单资金账户 (round 5, PR #305 review finding #1 -- never just any 账户状态 row that happens to match the currency, since two accounts can share a currency) that covers the computed order size, subject to TWO further checks round 6 found missing: (a) currency match -- that account's own 账户状态.币种 must be IDENTICAL to 计划新增仓位币种, never merely compared as raw numbers across currencies (this system does no FX conversion, so a JPY balance can never be read as covering a USD order no matter how large the JPY number is); (b) freshness -- that account's own 数据时间 must satisfy 0 <= (报告日期 - 数据时间) <= 7 days (a tighter window than the 30-day one used for the manual confirmations above, since a cash balance moves far more often than trading-unit/order-type/conversion facts, and this system runs daily) and must not be future-dated. No matching account, a currency mismatch, missing/future/stale 数据时间, or a clearly insufficient amount are all 无法确认 (round 2 finding #3: an unknown required input blocks the same as a known-insufficient one; name the shortfall or missing/stale data in 当前阻碍); only a confirmed-sufficient, currency-matched, fresh figure on that exact account reaches 可准备订单, which by this point means every one of #303's named preflight dimensions (cash, currency conversion, trading unit, order type, existing-order reservation, and plan-wide remaining budget across the whole lineage) has been affirmatively checked against the SAME funding account -- never silently assumed fine. Issue #306 price-policy preflight (maintainer decision A): before 可准备订单 can be reached, the current zone's 区间N价格 must itself state a single price or an explicit maximum (e.g. '≤180'), or the plan's own 订单类型 must explicitly state that the zone's range upper bound is that batch's maximum limit price; a bare range with no such explicit rule routes to 计划未完善停在核对 -- the order-limit path may never promote a range's upper bound to a limit price that the conditional 计划买入上限 display would itself call ambiguous.

fields.name: 建议限价
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. The applicable zone's own maximum limit price, copied/derived verbatim from the matching 入场计划.区间N价格 -- a transparent mechanical lookup, never a price Daily/Weekly computes or estimates independently. Populated only when 准备状态=可准备订单; blank in every other case, including 计划未完善停在核对 (the zone price may be known but the plan lacks other order parameters, so nothing is actually ready to prepare). Issue #306 (decision A): when 区间N价格 is a range, the upper bound is copied only if the plan's 订单类型 explicitly states that the range upper bound is the batch's maximum limit price (noting that basis, e.g. '11 USD（区间1 上沿，按计划订单类型规则）'); otherwise 准备状态 never reaches 可准备订单, so this field stays blank.

fields.name: 建议订单规模说明
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text order size derived by pure mechanical arithmetic -- the matching zone's 区间N占比 as a percentage of 入场计划.计划新增仓位金额 in 计划新增仓位币种 (e.g. '约 10,000 USD（区间1 占比 50% x 计划基数 20,000 USD）') -- never an executed share count, never a figure Daily/Weekly sets independently. Populated only when 准备状态=可准备订单, same shape as 建议限价. By that point (PR #305 round 3 review finding #2, extended round 4) every one of #303's named preflight dimensions has already been affirmatively checked by 准备状态's own decision steps: cash sufficiency, currency match, and freshness (0-7 days old, never future-dated) against the exact 账户状态 row named by 入场计划.订单资金账户 (round 6 finding #2), 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 against 入场计划's own manual confirmation fields (fresh -- 0 to 30 days old, never future-dated -- and bound to that same 订单资金账户, round 5 finding #1), and the plan's own remaining budget after subtracting what every other zone across the WHOLE plan lineage, including historical zones with no successor in the active version and excluding any whose own 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the active version's (round 5 finding #2, round 6 finding #1), has already reserved or consumed -- this field no longer needs a standing disclaimer for any of them, since a disclaimer in place of an actual check was exactly what round 2's version of this field got wrong. If a future preflight dimension is ever added without a corresponding confirmation field, it must gate 准备状态 the same way, never ride along as a disclaimer on this field instead.

fields.name: 计划订单有效期
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Verbatim snapshot of the referenced plan version's own 入场计划.订单有效期 policy -- never reworded or recomputed, same snapshot discipline as 入场计划估值锚点. Follows 入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间's shape: populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, independent of whether this run's price data was available, since it is a plan policy fact rather than a this-run evaluation result.

fields.name: 跳空处理提示
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Free-text note applying the plan's own 入场计划.跳空处理规则 when this run's price appears to have gapped past a zone's limit since the last evaluation -- restates the plan's existing policy, never invents a new gap rule or raises a limit price to chase the gap. Blank whenever no gap-past-limit condition applies this run, or when the plan itself has no 跳空处理规则 stated (in which case a gapped row's 当前阻碍 should carry a 计划未完善 note instead of this field fabricating a rule).

fields.name: 最近订单状态
fields.notes: Issue #303 Phase 2. Verbatim snapshot of the most recent relevant 入场执行反馈 row's own 订单状态 for this 代码 and zone, copied at evaluation time -- never derived, reworded, or inferred from price action. Blank whenever no 入场执行反馈 row exists for this 代码/zone yet (a missing row is a distinct state from an explicit 未知 value -- see that tab's own rules), or whenever 入场计划ID itself is blank.

fields.name: 今日行动
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 7. The single, canonical primary conclusion for this row -- what the user should do in the current trading session -- written by the report-generation layer (Daily/Weekly) via a fixed, total, safety-first mapping over fields this same row already carries plus one explicit, traceable lookup (the count of 状态=active 入场计划 rows for this 代码, from the same 入场计划 read the writer already performs for plan selection), never a new investment judgment and never re-derived by the Dashboard from several enums. Mapping, first match wins: (1) 入场计划ID blank AND the 入场计划 tab was read successfully this run AND it has zero 状态=active rows for this 代码 -> 无入场计划 (no planned incremental buy to act on; never a sell signal on an existing holding); (2) 入场计划ID blank in every other case -- one or more 状态=active rows exist for this 代码 but none could be reliably selected (the tied-maximum-版本 anomaly), or the 入场计划 tab could not be read -> 先核对缺项. Cases (1) and (2) share the same blank 报告持仓 row shape under the #298/#303 contract, so they are distinguished only by that explicit active-row count, never by an inferred, remembered, or out-of-band flag, and never by parsing 当前阻碍's free text; (3) 准备状态=可准备订单 AND 执行状态=可小额开始 AND (schema_version 8) the active plan's 订单类型 declares exactly one 执行路径 -> 可人工准备限价单 (no declared execution path -> 先核对缺项); 准备状态=可准备订单 with 执行状态=暂停复核 -> 暂停新增待复核 (a paused plan never advertises preparing a new order); 准备状态=可准备订单 with any other or blank 执行状态 -> 先核对缺项 (self-contradictory row, fail closed); (4) 准备状态=已有有效订单不重复建议 -> 已有订单勿重复; (5) 准备状态=无法确认 or 计划未完善停在核对 -> 先核对缺项; (6) 执行状态=暂停复核 -> 暂停新增待复核 (pausing a planned incremental buy, never a decision to reduce the holding); (7) 执行状态=等待确认 -> 等待确认; (8) 执行状态=等待价格 or 接近区间 -> 等待价格; (9) any other combination (including 执行状态=可小额开始 with 准备状态 blank or unrecognized) -> 先核对缺项 (fail closed). 可小额开始 is therefore never itself a primary conclusion: it is a secondary plan-condition state, and only 准备状态=可准备订单 together with 执行状态=可小额开始 can produce 可人工准备限价单. Populated on every newly written schema_version 7 row (no blank case); blank only on rows written before this column existed, which a reader must render with that row's own historical layout, never re-derive.
