A reader shows an unrecognized value neutrally, never as ready-to-buy, and shows 可人工准备限价单 as ready only when the same row also carries 执行状态=可小额开始, 准备状态=可准备订单 and non-blank 建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期 -- a contradictory row renders a neutral 'state contradiction, check first' state and a row missing order fields a neutral incomplete-order state naming them, never an order synthesized from other fields.

fields.name: 今日行动说明
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 7. One short free-text sentence carrying 今日行动's concrete next step and timing: what to do now, on which market trading day and in which exchange timezone to re-check or act, and what already-defined plan rule applies once the condition is met. Composed only from facts this row already carries (当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/计划订单有效期/跳空处理提示 and the active plan's own 技术确认条件/订单类型/订单有效期/跳空处理规则) -- never a new condition, date, price, or order parameter. Must name the one execution path the plan actually defines: a valuation-zone limit path (when a manual limit order may be prepared, the maximum price, and validity); a close-confirmation path (exchange and timezone, the official-close observation window and verifiable condition, the check day T, and that a limit order per the plan is prepared for the next exchange trading day T+1 -- an after-hours or pre-market quote never substitutes for the official close, and an exchange holiday moves T/T+1 to the next exchange trading day); or an event-confirmation path (re-review after the named disclosure/event; never implies buying the moment it happens when execution parameters are missing). For 可人工准备限价单 it must say the order is reviewed and submitted manually by the user, a gap open above the limit is not chased and the limit is never raised, and an unfilled/partially filled order follows its validity and order feedback rather than being re-suggested. For 先核对缺项 it names what is missing. For 已有订单勿重复 it says not to place a duplicate and to reconcile with the broker. For 无入场计划/暂停新增待复核 it states this is not a sell instruction for any existing holding. Same shape as 今日行动: populated whenever 今日行动 is populated.

fields.name: 计划买入上限
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 7. Conditional plan cap, NOT an order limit; 建议限价 still populates only at 准备状态=可准备订单 and the cap must equal it then. Batch selection is fail-closed: use one unambiguous next batch explicitly declared by the active plan's own 订单类型 (e.g. 下一执行批次=区间2 or 本轮只有区间2获配资金). Conflicting declarations or contradictions with the plan budget/zone definitions yield 需补全. Without that explicit declaration, require 当前区间 to equal exactly one zone label. Never infer the batch from ordinal order, a sole nonblank price, or budget size. The selected batch's feedback lineage must be resolved at every level (records present, no 未知, expired-unconfirmed orders or missing required pointers), and its price must state a single price or an explicit maximum; a range upper bound is allowed only under the plan's explicit upper-bound-as-limit policy, with that basis noted. Otherwise name the gap using 需补全. An explicitly declared next batch's conditional cap does not require the quote to be inside its zone, or even available. Preserve current-zone/execution/preparation states and every funding, feedback, price, time and event gate; show the applicable range and blockers and label it 尚不可据此下单 unless 今日行动=可人工准备限价单. Blank only without a reliably selected plan. Never substitute the quote, previous close or valuation anchor.

fields.name: 行情属性
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. Session attribute of the 当前价格 quote, shown next to it on the first screen so a reader never takes a delayed, after-hours or previous-close quote for a live order price: 盘中 (intraday), 正式收盘 (the exchange's official close), 盘后/盘前 (extended-hours), 过期 (older than the most recent exchange session the report could expect, e.g. a quote from two sessions ago), 未知 (the source does not say). Populated whenever 当前价格 is non-blank, for every row (with or without a plan); blank exactly when 当前价格 is blank. Never upgraded to look fresher than the source was.

fields.name: 报价币种
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. ISO currency code of 当前价格 (e.g. USD, JPY), copied from the data source or the holding's own 币种. Populated whenever 当前价格 is non-blank; blank exactly when 当前价格 is blank.

fields.name: 计划买入下限
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. Lower end of the first-screen 建议买入范围, taken from the SAME batch and the same fail-closed selection/lineage conditions as 计划买入上限 -- never from a different batch, the valuation anchor, the previous close or the quote. A batch whose 区间N价格 is a range: its lower endpoint verbatim plus the zone label (e.g. '165 USD（区间2）'). A single price is copied here only when the plan's 订单类型 explicitly declares it the only allowed price (then 下限 = 上限); a single price or explicit maximum without that declaration yields '需补全：计划只规定最高出价 X，未规定最低价' -- the cap is never copied down to fake a two-sided range. Any other gap uses a 需补全： reason. A missing lower bound is a display gap, not a buy gate and not a 阻塞待办ID entry: whether buying below the range pauses or re-reviews the plan is decided by the plan, never by a new blanket rule. Blank only without a reliably selected plan.

fields.name: 阻塞待办ID
fields.notes: Issue #306, schema_version 8. The 报告待办.待办ID values (same 报告ID and 生成ID) of every todo that blocks this row's 今日建议, separated by '、' or ','; the literal 无 when nothing blocks (blank or a missing column never counts as 无). Required non-blank on every newly written schema_version 8 row; blank only on rows written before this column existed. Every listed ID must exist in the same generation's 报告待办 with a non-completed 状态. 今日建议=无法判断, a 需补全 in 计划买入上限, and a plan with no declared execution path each require at least one ID whose todo names that exact gap; 适合买入 requires 无. A 需补全 in 计划买入下限 alone is a display gap, not a blocker: it is never listed here and never changes 今日建议 (its plan-maintenance todo is written as a separate, non-blocking todo). A reader resolves IDs only inside the generation being shown (current or history) and renders a missing, completed or unresolvable link as an explicit link anomaly, never as 'no blocker'.

rules: 资产类型=watchlist rows must never be aggregated or rendered as holdings.

For newly written 资产类型=watchlist rows, IOS状态 is the report-provided canonical recommended next action: exactly 研究建仓 / 等待估值 / 等待价格 / 继续观察 / 降低优先级. 优先级 and 价格位置 are independent fields; no Dashboard or other reader may infer IOS状态 from them, prices, or styling. Historical rows retain their stored IOS状态 verbatim; blank/unrecognized legacy values use a neutral presentation fallback rather than being recomputed.
A row whose 生成ID does not match the current 报告摘要 pointer for its 报告ID is stale/orphaned and must never be rendered or aggregated.

参考买入价/区间, 当前价格, and 价格位置 are informational reference data, not investment advice or an executable target -- see the Book/Prompt Suite's own 'all actual investment actions require human confirmation' boundary. A writer must never fabricate any of the three when its source data is unavailable.

入场计划ID/执行状态/当前区间/需要复核/入场计划估值锚点 (Issue #298) are a second, independent presentation track layered on top of 参考买入价/区间/价格位置, not a replacement of them in the schema -- when an active 入场计划 exists for a 代码, these five fields are the primary display and 参考买入价/区间/价格位置 are not rendered for that row at all; when no active plan exists, 参考买入价/区间/价格位置 remain the sole display exactly as before this feature existed. A reader must never show both a plan-based state and a legacy reference-price badge as two competing top-level recommendations for the same row.

These five fields follow exactly three field-value shapes, never a fourth improvised combination: (1) no active plan for this 代码 -- all five blank/false, legacy display used. (2) an active plan was reliably selected but this run's evaluation data (e.g. current price) was insufficient -- 入场计划ID and 入场计划估值锚点 stay populated (they depend only on which plan version was selected, never on current price), 执行状态/当前区间 stay blank, 需要复核 is set independently from the plan's own 计划复核触发 condition where that can itself be judged. (3) the tied-maximum-版本 anomaly (see 入场计划's own rules) -- shaped identically to case (1) (all five blank/false), with the anomaly reported only via a 报告待办 row, never by setting 需要复核 true on an otherwise-blank plan row. A writer must never blank 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点 merely because 执行状态 could not be computed (that recreates the legacy-fallback/competing-badge failure mode this feature exists to prevent), and must never set 需要复核 true without 入场计划ID also being populated.

Issue #303 Phase 1 adds seven further optional columns (入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间/行情截至时间/当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明), introduced in schema_version 5, layered on top of the five Issue #298 fields above. These seven fields follow THREE different shapes, not one uniform rule -- a round 2 review correction to an earlier draft that wrongly forced all seven to blank whenever 执行状态 was blank, which silently dropped the required report-time blocked-explanation/remediation content for exactly the cases that most need it (no active plan; a tied-version anomaly; an active plan whose evaluation data was unavailable this run). (a) 入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间 follow 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点's own shape: populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, blank only when there is no active plan or it could not be reliably selected. (b) 停止条件说明/较上次变化说明 follow that SAME 入场计划ID shape, not 执行状态's shape -- both are derivable from the plan's own stated conditions or from comparing plan identity/facts across reports, neither of which requires this run's price to be available; populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, blank only alongside it. (c) 行情截至时间 is populated only when this run actually used a priced quote, so it is blank whenever 入场计划ID is blank, the plan could not be reliably selected, OR this run's price data was itself unavailable -- and may legitimately stay blank even when evaluation succeeded, if the data source supplied no distinct as-of label beyond 报告日期 (a property of the data source, not an incomplete-plan case). (d) 当前阻碍/下次检查 follow neither shape above -- they are the report's blocked-explanation/remediation fields and must carry content in every situation where something needs explaining, INCLUDING when there is no active plan at all (explaining that research/valuation is incomplete and an existing 参考买入价/区间 is not order authorization) and when an active plan exists but this run's evaluation data was unavailable (an explicit 无法确认： message naming what was missing). 当前阻碍's only blank case is a reliably-selected, evaluated active plan at 执行状态=可小额开始 (nothing is blocking); 下次检查 has no blank case of its own once schema_version 5 is adopted -- even at 可小额开始 it still names the next check/remediation step, sourced from the plan's own 下一验证证据/计划复核触发 when a plan exists and was evaluated. Whenever 当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明 are expected to carry plan-condition-derived content (an active plan was reliably selected) but the plan itself does not specify the underlying condition (技术确认条件/不追高条件/失效条件/下一验证证据/计划复核触发 all blank, as relevant to that field), the writer must write an explicit incomplete-plan message (free text beginning with 计划未完善：) rather than leaving the cell blank. This is distinct from the 无法确认： message used when evaluation data (not the plan itself) was the missing ingredient, and from the fixed no-active-plan/tied-anomaly wording -- a reader tells these three situations apart by which message prefix appears, never by a blank cell. These rules never retroactively change the three-shape contract for the original five Issue #298 fields.

Issue #303 Phase 2 adds six further optional columns (准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期/跳空处理提示/最近订单状态), introduced in schema_version 6, layered on top of Phase 1's seven columns -- none of this is a trading instruction or an executed order; it is order-preparation information the user still must confirm and submit manually. 计划订单有效期/最近订单状态 follow 入场计划版本's shape (populated whenever 入场计划ID is populated, independent of this run's price data, since both are snapshots of policy/feedback facts rather than this-run evaluation results). 准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/跳空处理提示 depend on 执行状态 being populated and, for 建议限价/建议订单规模说明 specifically, on 准备状态 being exactly 可准备订单 -- see each field's own notes for the exact conditions. The narrowed Daily boundary (docs/v2.1-architecture.md) applies to all six: a writer may only perform transparent mechanical lookup/arithmetic against an already-existing, traceable, human-confirmed 入场计划 and 入场执行反馈 -- it must never set a new budget, threshold, entry price, or order parameter of its own, and must never treat a missing plan parameter as license to invent one. PR #305 review corrections (ten rounds): 准备状态's decision is fail-closed on missing/unknown/stale 入场执行反馈 and on an existing partial fill (never falls through to 可准备订单 in those cases, and never recomputes a partially filled zone's remaining size), and a later 已取消/未下单 report never erases an earlier recorded fill at the same key, whether that fill was recorded as a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量 OR evidenced solely by a 部分成交/已成交 订单状态 with no quantity ever supplied (已成交数量 is optional -- blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero') -- that capital is real and irreversible either way, so a cancellation of the unfilled remainder is 无法确认 pending manual reconciliation, never a green light to prepare the original full tranche again (round 7 finding, corrected round 8 to also cover status-only evidence); beyond that, since this tab has no broker synchronization, a key whose history shows any status implying an order existed (已挂单/部分成交/已成交, OR 已取消 itself -- round 10 finding: a key whose first/only report is 已取消 is not exempt just because IOS never separately saw a 已挂单 row) cannot be trusted as genuinely cleared by a later 已取消/未下单 on silence alone -- an undisclosed partial fill could have occurred before that report -- so the clearing row must itself affirmatively state 已成交数量=0 (round 9 finding; a key whose entire history is 未下单 with no order-existed status at all is exempt, since nothing could have filled); it walks each zone's structured 区间N上一版本对应区间 predecessor chain (never raw ordinal-label matching) to find an existing order across a plan revision, including one a revision reorders; it runs a cash preflight against the exact 账户状态 row named by 入场计划.订单资金账户 (round 5 finding #1 -- never any row that merely matches currency), requiring that row's own 币种 to exactly match 计划新增仓位币种 (never a raw cross-currency number comparison, round 6 finding #1) and its own 数据时间 to be within a 7-day, non-future-dated freshness window (round 6 finding #2), plus the manual 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 preflight confirmations, checked for freshness (0-30 days old, never future-dated -- round 5 corrected an age check a future date could trivially satisfy) and bound to that same 订单资金账户; and it aggregates reserved/consumed amounts across the WHOLE plan lineage -- not just the active version's own sibling zones, but every historical zone with no successor in the active version too (round 5 finding #2), excluding (fail-closed) any historical reservation whose own 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the active version's (round 6 finding #1) -- using each live order's own historical plan-version numbers, not the current version's -- to compute a remaining plan budget before confirming 可准备订单 -- see 准备状态/建议订单规模说明's own notes, 入场计划's own rules, and 入场执行反馈's own rules for the exact mechanics.

Issue #306 adds three further optional columns (今日行动/今日行动说明/计划买入上限), introduced in schema_version 7, appended after 最近订单状态. They separate four kinds of price a reader must never confuse: the market quote (当前价格 + 行情截至时间, never an order price), the long-term valuation anchor (入场计划估值锚点, a research judgment, never an order limit), the conditional plan cap (计划买入上限, not orderable unless 今日行动=可人工准备限价单), and the validated order limit (建议限价, only at 准备状态=可准备订单, still reviewed and submitted manually). 今日行动 is the one primary conclusion: a reader renders it (with 今日行动说明, the price-discipline line, 当前阻碍, and plan/quote freshness) first, and moves research narrative, valuation derivation, 执行状态, quotes, and change details into a secondary, collapsed-by-default layer -- 执行状态=可小额开始 is never rendered as a competing green primary action on such a row. When the plan itself is insufficient to give a price or prepare an order, 今日行动说明 names the specific plan fields a Weekly Deep Dive must complete, and Weekly writes one 报告待办 (跟进类型=可执行) per such 代码. A reader never derives 今日行动 or a price from other fields; a row without 今日行动 (written before schema_version 7) keeps its own historical layout, and history always shows the stored snapshot, never today's plan or order state.

Issue #306 (schema_version 8) adds four further optional columns (行情属性/报价币种/计划买入下限/阻塞待办ID) after 计划买入上限, plus 报告待办.待办ID, for the user-confirmed five-item first screen: (1) the report-time quote with currency, as-of time and session attribute, never an order price; (2) 今日建议, exactly one of 适合买入 / 等待 / 无法判断, given by the fixed shared mapping over 今日行动 -- 可人工准备限价单 -> 适合买入 only when the same row also has 执行状态=可小额开始, 准备状态=可准备订单, non-blank 建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期 and 阻塞待办ID is the literal 无 (blank or missing never counts; otherwise 无法判断); 等待价格/等待确认/已有订单勿重复/暂停新增待复核 -> 等待; 先核对缺项/无入场计划/blank/unknown -> 无法判断 -- the mapping is stored nowhere else and a reader never invents another verdict; (3) 建议买入范围 = 计划买入下限 and 计划买入上限 of one batch, each shown with its own 需补全 reason when missing, labelled 尚不可据此下单 unless 今日建议=适合买入; (4) the waiting reason (今日行动说明) for 等待; (5) the reason a verdict or price cannot be generated plus links to the exact blocker todos (阻塞待办ID), or an explicit 无. Everything else (valuation anchor, plan version, research text, internal enums, lineage, order size/validity/path) is folded by default. A history generation shows its own snapshot labelled 当时建议 with its own date. Before publishing a generation the writer runs the pre-publish consistency checks of both report prompts and never publishes a row that fails them: 执行状态 vs zones, 今日行动 vs the fixed mapping, the 可人工准备限价单 completeness/consistency, blocker links resolving inside the same generation, two-sided range from one batch, quote attribute/currency present with the quote, and no self-contradicting free text in the same row.

报告风险.purpose: Per-risk detail rows for a given (报告ID, 生成ID).

fields.notes: Issue #267, schema_version 3. Distinguishes actionable work the user/Agent can advance now from an ongoing monitoring condition (e.g. 'continue tracking NVIDIA Rubin ramp/margins') and an item genuinely blocked on an external event (e.g. a pending board decision or filing) -- so the Dashboard's todo/backlog view doesn't misrepresent recurring monitoring or an evidence-wait as accumulating unfinished work. Canonical machine values are these literal Chinese strings; the GAS Dashboard renders them, it does not translate or reinterpret them. A rerun where the Sheet was read successfully and this tab is conclusively absent may treat the installation as a pre-_安装状态 legacy install and enter the bootstrap path. A rerun where the Sheet or this tab could not be read at all (permission/API error, timeout) must Block with no schema or Task mutation -- it must never be treated the same as a confirmed-absent tab.

Under schema_version 1, report_table_names_* must always equal the canonical defaults (报告摘要/报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办) -- no consumer (Task templates, GAS Dashboard) reads a custom value yet. An installer must reject a user's request to rename these tabs rather than writing a non-default value that no reader/writer actually honors.

report_write_protocol.description: How a writer commits one 报告ID's data across four tabs without a native cross-tab transaction. Full rationale in docs/v2.1-architecture.md's 'Report write protocol' section.
steps: 1. Generate: mint a fresh 生成ID for this write attempt (first attempt or retry alike); never reuse a prior attempt's 生成ID.

2. Plan: BEFORE writing any row, fix two things for each of the four sections this generation must contain once staging finishes -- 报告持仓 rows with 资产类型=holding, 报告持仓 rows with 资产类型=watchlist, 报告风险 rows, 报告待办 rows: (a) the exact set of row identities (each holding/watchlist row's 代码/名称, or an equivalent stable per-item key decided for that 报告风险/报告待办 item) this generation must contain, and (b) the count that set implies. A count alone is not a complete plan -- a stage that drops one planned item while duplicating another can preserve the count while still being wrong, so steps 4 and 6 must check identities, not merely counts. What belongs in the plan is report-type-specific, not one universal rule: 报告持仓(holding) is always the complete set of current holdings, for both Daily and Weekly; 报告持仓(watchlist) for a Weekly generation is the complete current 观察名单 (Issue #293 requires every watchlist row to receive a fresh weekly priority result every time), while for a Daily generation it is only the subset that report type's own canonical selection rule authorizes (currently 观察名单 rows with 优先级=高 -- the canonical value defined by Issue #293's weekly priority review; a legacy row still carrying the pre-#293 English high value reads as equivalent but must never be newly written -- per setup/daily-task-prompt.md) -- a Daily plan must never expand to the full watchlist, and a Weekly plan must never narrow below it; 报告风险/报告待办 items are whatever this run's own analysis decided to report, fixed here before staging, never derived afterward from whatever ends up staged.

3. Stage: write EVERY 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 row that should exist under the new generation -- not only the rows this run actually recomputed. A row carried forward unchanged from the previous generation (e.g. a holding whose thesis didn't change this run) must still be (re)written under the new (报告ID, 生成ID), because the read contract in step 7 matches by exact 生成ID: a row left tagged with the OLD 生成ID becomes invisible the moment 报告摘要 switches to the new one. A generation must never be partial -- writing some tables/rows under the new 生成ID while leaving others on a prior 生成ID reproduces the 2026-09-05 incident (a Weekly rerun that only re-staged watchlist rows under a new 生成ID left holdings/risks on the old one, so the Dashboard correctly rendered 0 holdings once 报告摘要 switched). The existing 报告摘要 row, if any, is untouched during this step -- readers still see the last known-good generation.

4. Verify (pre-switch, fail-closed): read back the staged rows for (报告ID, 生成ID) and compare them against step 2's plan on BOTH axes for every section -- the count, and the exact set of row identities. An exact count match achieved by the wrong set of identities (a planned item missing, an extra/duplicate item present) is still a failure, not merely an approximate or partial one, and never a comparison against vague intent instead of the fixed plan from step 2. Stop here on any mismatch -- 报告摘要 stays untouched (it still references the prior generation, or nothing, for a first attempt) and the staged rows become orphans (step 8). A watchlist-only generation whose holdings/risks counts stayed at zero while step 2 planned nonzero holdings/risks is exactly the 2026-09-05 incident's shape, and this comparison is what must catch it before step 5 ever runs.
5. Switch: only after step 4's verification succeeds, create/update the single 报告摘要 row for 报告ID with the new 生成ID. This single-row write is the actual commit point.

6. Confirm (post-switch, fail-closed): after the switch lands, re-read 报告摘要 for this 报告ID and confirm its 生成ID now equals the value just written; re-read 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 filtered to this exact (报告ID, 生成ID) and compare them against step 2's plan again on both axes -- count and exact row identities. A run may only report success (its own run status and any user-facing notification) once this confirmation succeeds. If confirmation fails for any reason -- an unexpected 生成ID read back, any section's count or identity set off, or the re-read itself failing -- the run must surface failure/needs-attention through its own run status and must NOT send a success notification, even though 报告摘要 has already switched; this is a distinct failure class from a pre-switch (step 4) failure precisely because the publish already happened, and it needs the same visibility, not less.
7. Read contract: a reader only trusts 报告持仓/报告风险/报告待办 rows whose 生成ID matches the 生成ID currently in that 报告ID's 报告摘要 row.

8. Cleanup: rows from superseded/orphaned generations may be deleted at any later point (next successful run, periodic sweep) -- this is never a precondition for correctness, since step 7 already makes them inert.

9. Failure/retry: a run that fails before step 5 leaves 报告摘要 pointing at the last known-good 生成ID (or absent, for a first attempt); the failure is surfaced via the Task's own run status, never by a partial 报告摘要 write. A run whose step 6 confirmation fails after step 5's switch already landed must likewise surface failure via its own run status/notification, never by a second silent 报告摘要 write. Either way, a retry restarts at step 1 with a new 生成ID.

blocked_vs_empty.description: A report's 核心状态 must distinguish these -- conflating them was a Phase A review finding.
blocked_vs_empty.blocked: A required tab could not be read at all, a required column is missing, or the Sheet's schema_version is incompatible with what the Task knows how to handle.
blocked_vs_empty.valid_empty_result: A tab was read successfully and legitimately has zero matching rows (e.g. an empty 观察名单, or a user holding no current positions). This is normal portfolio state and must never be treated as Blocked or degrade the report's status.

rules: Applies to every tab, including the four 报告* tabs: a schema_version bump must not delete or rewrite existing rows by default. A historical report row is not necessarily reproducible by re-running the Task that produced it, so 报告* rows are not disposable just because they are system-generated.
A schema_version bump must never overwrite an existing user-entered cell in 当前持仓, 交易记录, or 观察名单 without explicit user approval.

The report_write_protocol's atomic replace-by-生成ID mechanism is a normal write-time operation scoped to one 报告ID's own re-run -- it is not a schema migration, and migration logic must not treat it as a general license to rewrite report history.

A genuinely destructive migration (a change no existing row can be read against additively) must be its own explicit, versioned step: back up first, provide a documented rollback, and require explicit user approval before running against a real installation -- never silently bundled into an ordinary installer upgrade.
A future breaking schema_version change must be documented with an explicit upgrade path in this file's own changelog (none yet -- this is schema_version 1).

schema_changelog.summary: Adds 账户状态 (account/capital facts: cash by currency/account, New NISA remaining capacity, planned additional capital, recurring tsumitate instructions) and 投资信托明细 (fund-sleeve detail sufficient to reconcile an aggregate 当前持仓 FUND-SLEEVE row without double-counting). No existing tab's fields were removed, renamed, or reordered; every schema_version 1 Sheet remains fully readable as-is.
schema_changelog.migration: Purely additive -- an installer upgrading a schema_version 1 Sheet adds these two tabs (header-only, no example data) and bumps _安装状态.schema_version to 2. A Sheet that has not been upgraded (these tabs entirely absent, not merely empty) continues to work exactly as it did under schema_version 1: the Weekly Task falls back to the legacy _安装状态.weekly_cash_context mechanism for the required '当前现金或资金状态' input, and 当前持仓 continues to work as a single aggregate FUND-SLEEVE row (if any) with no reconciliation available.

schema_changelog.summary: Adds 跟进类型 to 报告待办 (可执行/持续观察/等待证据), distinguishing actionable follow-up work from ongoing monitoring and waiting-for-external-evidence items so the Dashboard's todo/backlog view doesn't misrepresent recurring monitoring or an evidence-wait as unfinished work. No existing tab's fields were removed, renamed, or reordered; every schema_version 1 or 2 Sheet remains fully readable as-is, and existing 报告待办 rows without this column are read identically to a row whose 跟进类型 is 可执行 (the safe default) -- no historical row needs rewriting.
schema_changelog.migration: Purely additive -- an installer upgrading a schema_version 1 or 2 Sheet adds the 跟进类型 header to the existing 报告待办 tab (no backfill of historical rows' cells) and bumps _安装状态.schema_version to 3. A Sheet that has not been upgraded (the column entirely absent) continues to work exactly as it did before: every 报告待办 row reads as 可执行, matching this version's own blank-value default, so nothing about existing Daily/Weekly Task output or Dashboard rendering changes until the column is added and a Task starts populating it.

schema_changelog.summary: Adds 入场计划 (a durable, Deep-Dive-owned execution plan: long-term valuation anchor, a stated planned-incremental-allocation basis, up to three ordered entry zones each with a maximum share of that allocation, bounded timing/technical condition, no-chase condition, thesis-invalidation condition, next evidence item, and a plan-refresh trigger) and five report-snapshot fields on 报告持仓 (入场计划ID/执行状态/当前区间/需要复核/入场计划估值锚点) that let Daily/Weekly evaluate the active plan against current price and snapshot its anchor, without ever rewriting the plan's own static fields. No existing tab's fields were removed, renamed, or reordered; every schema_version 1-3 Sheet remains fully readable as-is, and existing 报告持仓 rows without the five new columns read identically to a row whose 入场计划ID is blank (the safe fallback to the pre-existing 参考买入价/区间/价格位置 display) -- no historical row needs rewriting.
schema_changelog.migration: Purely additive -- an installer upgrading a schema_version 1-3 Sheet adds the 入场计划 tab (header-only, no example data) and the five new 报告持仓 columns (appended at the end, after 排序, so the canonical field order here matches physical append position exactly -- see the same append-only convention established for schema_version 3's 跟进类型) and bumps _安装状态.schema_version to 4. A Sheet that has not been upgraded (the tab and columns entirely absent) continues to work exactly as it did before this feature existed: Daily/Weekly continue writing only 参考买入价/区间/价格位置, and the Dashboard continues to show that as the sole display for every asset.

schema_changelog.summary: Adds seven report-snapshot columns to 报告持仓 (入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间/行情截至时间/当前阻碍/下次检查/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明) so a Daily/Weekly report row can answer, using only canonical report data, what to do right now, why (or what is blocking it), when to check again, and what changed since the previous report for the same 代码 -- without the Dashboard inferring any of this itself. 入场计划版本/入场计划数据时间/停止条件说明/较上次变化说明 are plan-identity/plan-condition snapshots following the same shape as the existing 入场计划ID/入场计划估值锚点 (schema_version 4) -- populated whenever an active plan was reliably selected, independent of this run's price data; 行情截至时间 is populated only when this run actually used a priced quote; 当前阻碍/下次检查 are report-time blocked-explanation/remediation fields that must carry content even with no active plan or with missing evaluation data (an explicit 无法确认： or no-plan message, never a blank cell), and must carry an explicit 计划未完善： message rather than a blank cell whenever a reliably-selected active plan itself lacks the condition text needed to answer them. No existing tab's fields were removed, renamed, or reordered; every schema_version 1-4 Sheet remains fully readable as-is, and existing 报告持仓 rows without these seven columns read identically to a row whose 入场计划ID is blank -- no historical row needs rewriting. This is the first installment of Issue #303's two-phase execution-explanation closure; Phase 2 (order parameters and manual order feedback) is a separate, not-yet-implemented future schema change.
schema_changelog.migration: Purely additive -- an installer upgrading a schema_version 1-4 Sheet adds the seven new 报告持仓 columns (appended at the end, after 入场计划估值锚点, so the canonical field order here matches physical append position exactly -- see the same append-only convention established for schema_version 3's 跟进类型 and schema_version 4's five Issue #298 columns) and bumps _安装状态.schema_version to 5. A Sheet that has not been upgraded (the columns entirely absent) continues to work exactly as it did before this feature existed: Daily/Weekly continue writing only the schema_version 4 five-field evaluation, and the Dashboard continues to render exactly that -- no card shows a 计划未完善 message or any Phase 1 explanation line for a Sheet that has not adopted these columns.

schema_changelog.summary: Adds five order-policy columns to 入场计划 (计划新增仓位币种/计划新增仓位金额/订单类型/订单有效期/跳空处理规则, all Deep-Dive-owned), a new 入场执行反馈 tab (durable, user-authorized, append-only order-status feedback: 未下单/已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消/未知, keyed to a specific plan version and zone), and six report-snapshot columns on 报告持仓 (准备状态/建议限价/建议订单规模说明/计划订单有效期/跳空处理提示/最近订单状态). This is Issue #303 Phase 2: order-preparation information computed by transparent mechanical lookup/arithmetic against an already-existing, traceable, human-confirmed plan -- never a new budget/threshold/entry-point decision, and never an executable buy/sell instruction. All actual order submission remains the user's own action. No existing tab's fields were removed, renamed, or reordered; every schema_version 1-5 Sheet remains fully readable as-is, and existing 报告持仓 rows without these six columns read identically to a row whose 入场计划ID is blank -- no historical row needs rewriting. This is the second and final installment of Issue #303's two-phase execution-explanation closure. PR #305 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): 准备状态 is fail-closed on missing/unknown/stale 入场执行反馈 and on an existing partial fill, scans for an existing order across a 代码's whole plan-version lineage by zone label rather than only the current active 计划ID, and runs a cash preflight against 账户状态 before confirming 可准备订单; 入场执行反馈 gained an idempotency/replay rule and a same-day tie-break rule; the Task-prompt direct instructions were corrected to match this canonical decision table exactly (they had collapsed the missing-evaluation-data case into the no-active-plan blank case). PR #305 round 3 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): added structured, machine-checkable 区间1/2/3上一版本对应区间 fields to 入场计划 so a batch-identity lookup correctly follows a zone across a plan revision that reorders it, replacing the round 2 fix's free-text 全新资金 escape hatch; added 交易单位确认/订单类型可用性确认/换汇可行性确认 manual preflight confirmation fields so trading unit, order-type support, and currency conversion feasibility are affirmatively checked (same user-authorized-fact pattern as 账户状态) before 报告持仓.准备状态 can reach 可准备订单, rather than relying on a standing disclaimer. PR #305 round 4 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): added 交易单位确认时间/订单类型可用性确认时间/换汇可行性确认时间 fields so the round 3 confirmations are checked for a freshness window, instead of a long-lived unstamped string silently authorizing a later preparation; and added a plan-level budget-reservation step to 报告持仓.准备状态's decision order (now seven steps) that aggregates reserved/consumed amounts using each live order's own historical plan-version numbers before confirming 可准备订单, so multiple zones of one plan can no longer each pass an isolated cash check while jointly exceeding the plan's own 计划新增仓位金额. PR #305 round 5 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): replaced round 4's per-field 换汇可行性确认账户 with a single shared 订单资金账户 field binding ALL three manual confirmations (not just 换汇可行性确认) to the one account that will actually fund the order, since trading-unit and order-type support can differ by account even within the same currency; fixed the freshness rule to require 0<=age<=30 days (a future-dated confirmation previously passed trivially); and generalized the budget-reservation scan from the active version's own sibling zones to the WHOLE plan lineage, so a historical zone with no successor in the active version (e.g. a dropped predecessor zone that still has a live order) is no longer silently omitted from the reserved total. PR #305 round 6 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): the cash preflight now requires the named 订单资金账户's own 账户状态.币种 to exactly match 计划新增仓位币种 (a cross-currency balance was previously compared as a raw number, which could pass a USD order against a JPY balance) and its own 数据时间 to be within a 7-day, non-future-dated freshness window (previously unchecked entirely); the budget-reservation scan now also excludes, fail-closed, any historical reservation whose own 计划新增仓位币种 differs from the active version's, since this system does no currency conversion and cannot net mismatched-currency amounts as raw numbers. PR #305 round 7 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): a later 已取消/未下单 report for a (代码,关联计划ID,对应区间) key that earlier recorded a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量 is no longer treated as 'clear' -- a cancellation of the unfilled remainder never reverses shares already bought, so this now fails closed to 无法确认 (manual reconciliation) instead of letting 报告持仓.准备状态 fall through to 可准备订单 and authorize preparing the original full tranche on top of capital already invested. PR #305 round 8 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): the round 7 fix only scanned for a non-blank, nonzero 已成交数量; since 已成交数量 is optional per 入场执行反馈's own field notes (blank means 'not reported,' never 'zero'), a 部分成交/已成交 row that never recorded a quantity was wrongly treated as leaving no fill evidence, so a later 已取消/未下单 on that same key could fall through to 可准备订单 despite a real prior fill -- now a row whose own 订单状态 is 部分成交/已成交 is itself sufficient fill evidence, independent of whether 已成交数量 was ever populated. PR #305 round 9 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): rounds 7-8 still let a key with NO recorded fill evidence at all (neither a nonzero quantity nor a 部分成交/已成交 status) default to 'genuinely clear' on a later 已取消/未下单 -- but this tab has no broker synchronization, so a key once reported 已挂单 could have partially filled and been cancelled without that fill ever being disclosed; absence of a recorded fill is not proof of zero consumption. Now, once a key was ever 已挂单, its clearing 已取消/未下单 row must affirmatively state 已成交数量=0 (an explicit zero, not a blank) to count as reconciled, else 无法确认; a key never reported 已挂单 at all remains exempt, since nothing could have filled. PR #305 round 10 review correction (same schema_version 6, pre-merge): round 9's exemption was keyed on ORDER_PLACED_STATUSES={已挂单,部分成交,已成交}, which excluded 已取消 itself -- so a key whose FIRST/ONLY ever report was 已取消 with 已成交数量 blank was wrongly exempted as though the order had never been placed, when a cancellation inherently implies an order existed to cancel. Now 已取消 itself counts as order-existed evidence (scanning the whole history including the current row), so the exemption applies ONLY to a key whose entire history is 未下单 with no 已挂单/部分成交/已成交/已取消 at all; a later 未下单 is also no longer exempt if an earlier 已取消/已挂单/部分成交/已成交 anywhere in that key's history already proves an order once existed.
